<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 3"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Abadar's Flawless Scale](/Equipment.aspx?ID=562)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Gods & Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=17) pg. 121

**Price** 50 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

**Access** follower of Abadar

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This immaculate golden set of merchant’s scales is considered a divine instrument among Abadar’s most faithful. Unlike most scales, this one has only a single dish for placing small objects, and calculates value rather than weight. On the other side of the fulcrum, a steel arrow indicator points to various numbers engraved on the side of the scale. By placing an object of light Bulk onto the dish, you can determine its value in gold pieces in the market in which the scale was made (most of these scales are made in Katapesh or Absalom), based on its material composition and artisanship. For example, after placing a gemstone on the dish, the scale will indicate the fairest (average, in most cases) price you can expect to fetch in the market to which the scale is calibrated, but the scale wouldn’t detect the gemstone’s historical significance or any magical properties. _Abadar’s flawless scale_ can be calibrated to a different market by performing a 1-hour ritual in the proximity of that market.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 2"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Abidance Blinders](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3953)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 148

**Price** 25 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn headwear (animal) and worn headwear (you)

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

While many skilled cavalry units have their own beloved mounts, troops often need to make do with whatever animals are available for mounted combat. These blinders, made of dark brown leather, nearly cover an animal’s eyes and prevent it from seeing the dangers around them. It takes 1 minute to affix the blinders on an animal, whose attitude toward you must be indifferent or better. These blinders can be used only on a domesticated animal that doesn’t have combat training or the [minion](/Traits.aspx?ID=653) trait. Animals with these blinders on do not suffer from the [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) condition due to being in combat, nor do they automatically flee combat, as would be normal for an [animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=2219) without combat training. Unless mounted by a rider with the paired headband, which is braided from the same dark brown leather, the animal’s speed is reduced to 10 feet.

**Activate—It Can’t Hurt You** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** An animal within 30 feet wearing the paired blinders attempts a saving throw against a [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598) effect but hasn’t rolled yet;  **Effect** You grant a +1 status bonus to its saving throw against the triggering effect.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Gadget" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=405" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 67

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All Pathfinder Society agents have access to all uncommon clockwork items and gadgets from Chapters 1 and 2 of this book_

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** attached to a shield

**Bulk** 1
</row>

**Access**  Due to the use of technology, all gadgets are uncommon or rare, though inventors and regions with access to inventors have access to uncommon gadgets.

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Ablative shield plating is an amalgam device that provides a layer of additional protection for a shield. Ablative shield plating is cobbled together from parts of other shields, wires, scraps, and bits of detritus, adding mass to a shield. The process of attaching ablative shield plating takes 10 minutes, and you can't attach ablative shield plating to a shield that has any other attached item, such as a [shield boss](/Weapons.aspx?ID=41) or [shield spikes](/Weapons.aspx?ID=42). When the shield is damaged, this additional material crumples, breaks, and falls apart, absorbing some of the energy of the blow. Otherwise, the additional material slowly crumbles over time. Applying the plating grants the shield temporary Hit Points that last for the stated duration or until lost. Removing the plating early destroys it.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Aboutface Figurehead](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2623)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Figurehead" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=512" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 176

**Price** 980 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** attached to a ship's bow

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This otherwise plain-looking figurehead has the concerned expression of someone afraid they're being chased. If the vessel the figurehead is attached to has the sluggish vehicle ability, the figurehead suppresses that ability. Captains frequently give the ability to activate an _aboutface figurehead_ to the person at the helm of their ship.

**Activate—About Face!** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [move](/Traits.aspx?ID=114)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The figurehead turns its head as if to look behind it, spawning a momentary whirlpool under the ship and turbulent winds directly opposite the ship's heading. The ship makes a 180-degree turn in place, then continues heading in this new direction starting next turn.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Source** [Grand Bazaar](/Sources.aspx?ID=100) pg. 96 --- A blue-green metal with an eerie green luminescence, abysium radiates power that's inimical to life. Careless exposure to the material can lead to long-term damage to the immune system; as such, mining abysium is hazardous, as large quantities of the metal in an area cause all nearby creatures to become sick. A creature carrying an abysium object is [sickened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34) for a standard-grade object of light Bulk, sickened 2 for a standard-grade object of 1 Bulk or more or a high-grade object of light Bulk, or sickened 3 for a high-grade object of 1 Bulk or more. This and all other sickening effects of abysium are [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126) effects. Crafters can use 1 abysium chunk to create up to 6 doses of poisonous [abysium powder](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1407). Unscrupulous smiths have harnessed abysium's toxic properties to create noxious weapons and deadly substances. All objects crafted from abysium shed dim light in a 10-foot radius. ## Abysium

---

Typically only creatures immune to abysium's effects would don abysium armor. You're [sickened 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34) while wearing standard-grade armor made from abysium, or sickened 3 while wearing high-grade armor made from abysium. You can't reduce your sickened condition while wearing abysium armor, or for 1 hour after removing it. Abysium armor is dangerous to nearby creatures, too. Creatures within 10 feet of abysium armor must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC 30 for standard grade or DC 40 for high grade) or become sickened 1 (sickened 2 on a critical failure). Afterwards, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute, but if they remain within the area for longer than 1 minute, they automatically critically fail the next save.

**Source** [Grand Bazaar](/Sources.aspx?ID=100) pg. 96 --- A blue-green metal with an eerie green luminescence, abysium radiates power that's inimical to life. Careless exposure to the material can lead to long-term damage to the immune system; as such, mining abysium is hazardous, as large quantities of the metal in an area cause all nearby creatures to become sick. A creature carrying an abysium object is [sickened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34) for a standard-grade object of light Bulk, sickened 2 for a standard-grade object of 1 Bulk or more or a high-grade object of light Bulk, or sickened 3 for a high-grade object of 1 Bulk or more. This and all other sickening effects of abysium are [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126) effects. Crafters can use 1 abysium chunk to create up to 6 doses of poisonous [abysium powder](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1407). Unscrupulous smiths have harnessed abysium's toxic properties to create noxious weapons and deadly substances. All objects crafted from abysium shed dim light in a 10-foot radius. ## Abysium

Unscrupulous smiths have harnessed abysium's toxic properties to create noxious weapons and deadly substances. <row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

---

Although not all wizards have gone through formal training, it's become tradition to enchant robes representing the arduous training required and festoon them with honors one has earned. Typically, an _accolade robe_ is styled after a single wizard school, with appropriate colors and symbols. Wearing these robes grants a +2 item bonus to Arcana checks.

 The pockets of the robe tie to an extradimensional space that can hold 1 Bulk of items, none of which can have greater than light Bulk. The items must be related to spellcasting and academics—spellbooks, scrolls, wands, scholarly journals, and other academic supplies the GM allows. These items do not count against your Bulk limit. You can Interact to retrieve or stow items normally. 

**Activate—Review** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You retrieve an item of your choice from the robe's storage, then Recall Knowledge. 

**Activate—Extra Credit** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to cast a school spell. If you don't spend this Focus Point by the end of this turn, it is lost.

**Craft Requirements** You are a wizard of the associated school.

>
[Accompaniment Cloak](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2318)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Focused" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=74" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Occult" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=120" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 147

**Price** 1,300 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This lush velvet capelet is embroidered with images of musicians playing a wide variety of instruments. The images animate when you make art, remaining embroidered, but smoothly unknitting and reknitting in time with your performance. The figures play music that perfectly accompanies your instrument, voice, or movements, granting you a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can use only to cast a bard [composition](/Traits.aspx?ID=31) spell. If not used by the end of your turn, this Focus Point is lost.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You peel the musicians from the garment and fling them around you. The cloak casts a 4th-rank [_phantom crowd_](/Spells.aspx?ID=968) spell (DC 28); each of the 10-foot squares must be adjacent to you. The crowd looks like the musicians on the garment and continues to accompany your Performance checks. You can Sustain this effect as described in the spell.

**Craft Requirements** You are a [bard](/Classes.aspx?ID=3).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

This set of _[+1 resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2804) [explorer’s clothing](/Armor.aspx?ID=39)_ is lined with magically reinforced carved bones that are connected with reinforced sinews to provide the wearer both comfort and mobility. Spikes and spines of various shapes and sizes jut menacingly from the shoulder and forearm coverings. When you wear this outfit, you gain a +2 item bonus to [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44) checks. 

**Activate—Piercing Vengeance** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** An enemy damages you with a melee Strike;  **Effect** Jagged spines from your clothing launch themselves at the triggering enemy, dealing 6d6 piercing damage with a DC 26 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save.

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Cheliax, Infernal Inheritence](/Sources.aspx?ID=372) pg. 80

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) Pathfinder Society agents should not strike deals with devils without Decemvirate approval._

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Infernal tongues spread word of your great deeds. Creatures that would have an initial attitude toward you other than hostile have their attitude improved by one step. Once per day, from any distance, the devil who holds your _bargained contract_ can cite a defamation clause, rendering you unable to speak for 1 hour. 

**Activate—Entreat Crowd** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), subtle) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You invoke a due diligence stipulation in your contract. Attempt a [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) check to make a [Request](/Actions.aspx?ID=2393) of the creature with the highest Will DC within 100 feet who isn't your ally; the GM might have you make a Request of the most influential creature instead. The result applies to all creatures within 100 feet that can understand you.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 130 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** 1 --- Iron strips line the body of an _accursed staff_, capping the bottom and folding into an intricate knot at the top. While wielding an _accursed staff_, you're empowered by the curses you inflict. If an enemy fails a saving throw against a spell you cast that has the [curse](/Traits.aspx?ID=38) trait, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to double that spell's level. These temporary Hit Points last 10 minutes. The enemy must be a significant threat and can't have been a willing subject of the curse. **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Effect** You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list. **Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of all listed levels of all listed spells. <row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Two Actions" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Kept as a closely guarded secret by the deadly members of the [Red Mantis assassins](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3379), this poison is treated with reverence for its ability to end lives. If the victim dies while affected by this poison, its body decomposes to nothing in 1 minute, leaving only its gear behind. Non-magical preservation can’t protect the tainted corpse. [_Peaceful rest_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1625) works on the poisoned body only if cast as a 5th-rank spell and the caster succeeds at a [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) check against the poison’s saving throw DC when casting the spell. Even if cast successfully, peaceful rest only works as if it had been cast at 2nd rank.

 **Saving Throw** DC 42 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 7d12 poison damage and [doomed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=9) (1 round); **Stage 2** 9d12 poison damage and doomed 2 (1 round) **Stage 3** 11d12 poison damage and doomed 3 (1 round)

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Talisman" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=155" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 184

**Price** 5 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** affixed to a firearm

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Free Action" /><row>([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))</row></row>

 

 

**Requirement** You're wielding the affixed firearm.
</row>

</column>

---

This tiny copper gear is attached to the side of a firearm with a matching bolt or pin. When you activate it, the affixed weapon magically transfigures itself into the form of any simple or martial firearm to which you have access, harmlessly ejecting any contained ammunition in the process. Any runes or attached items present on the affixed weapon remain active unless incompatible with its new form, in which case they're suppressed for the duration of the transformation. The effect lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Elixir" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=59" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Legends](/Sources.aspx?ID=40) pg. 72

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

When you use a dose of addiction suppressant, it suppresses the effects of that addiction for 1 day, as if you had taken an actual dose of the [drug](/Traits.aspx?ID=261), but without any of the drug's effects, and it doesn't increase the addiction DC. You also gain an item bonus against the ongoing save against the drug's addiction depending on the type of addiction suppressant.

For every drug, a specific suppressant must be crafted— no generalized addiction suppressant yet exists. In order to create an addiction suppressant, you must begin with a dose of the drug to be suppressed, then use alchemical reagents to generate an elixir that can be used to fight that drug's addiction. An addiction suppressant must be a higher level than the drug it is meant to suppress in order to work.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Elixir" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=59" />
<trait label="Healing" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=89" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 58

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

When you use a dose of addiction suppressant, it suppresses the effects of that addiction for 1 day, as if you had taken an actual dose of the drug, but without any of the drug’s effects, and it doesn’t increase the addiction DC. You also gain an item bonus against the ongoing save against the drug’s addiction depending on the type of addiction suppressant.

For every drug, a specific suppressant must be crafted— no generalized addiction suppressant yet exists. In order to create an addiction suppressant, you must begin with a dose of the drug to be suppressed, then use alchemical reagents to generate an elixir that can be used to fight that drug’s addiction. An addiction suppressant must be a higher level than the drug it is meant to suppress in order to work.

**Special** An addiction suppressant has the same rarity as the specific drug it’s crafted to suppress.

[Addiction Suppressant](/Equipment.aspx?ID=774)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Elixir" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=59" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Legends](/Sources.aspx?ID=40) pg. 72

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

When you use a dose of addiction suppressant, it suppresses the effects of that addiction for 1 day, as if you had taken an actual dose of the [drug](/Traits.aspx?ID=261), but without any of the drug's effects, and it doesn't increase the addiction DC. You also gain an item bonus against the ongoing save against the drug's addiction depending on the type of addiction suppressant.

For every drug, a specific suppressant must be crafted— no generalized addiction suppressant yet exists. In order to create an addiction suppressant, you must begin with a dose of the drug to be suppressed, then use alchemical reagents to generate an elixir that can be used to fight that drug's addiction. An addiction suppressant must be a higher level than the drug it is meant to suppress in order to work.

</column>

</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Age of Ashes</spoilers>

<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #147: Tomorrow Must Burn](/Sources.aspx?ID=8) pg. 71

**Price** 58 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Certain Scarlet Triad poisoners use toxins like addlebrain to keep captured prisoners docile and compliant for short periods of time until they can be properly shackled and imprisoned. Addlebrain is distilled from a hallucinogenic lichen that can often be found growing in the sewers below particularly large cities like Katapesh.

 Once soaked in special reagents and then dried, a dose of addlebrain must be either lit with flame or tossed into a fire to activate, whereupon it unleashes a cloud of toxin as normal for an inhaled poison.

 **Saving Throw** DC 25 Fortitude; **Onset** 1 minute; **Maximum Duration** 1 day; **Stage 1** [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) 1 and [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) 1 (10 minutes); **Stage 2** enfeebled 2 and stupefied 2 (1 hour); **Stage 3** [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=15), enfeebled 4, and stupefied 4 (1 day)

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 148

**Price** 900 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn headwear

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This ostentatious hat is trimmed with gold thread and tiny jewels, all proclaiming your position of authority on the high seas. While wearing the bicorne, you gain a +2 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) and Sailing [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=41) checks.

**Activate—Fight On** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You take damage from an enemy’s [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) or spell attack roll;  **Effect** Despite your wounds, your troops are inspired to fight on. For 1 minute, all allies in a 30-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598) effects.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 7"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Admirer's Bouquet](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1758)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Kingmaker</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Kingmaker Companion Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=151) pg. 84

**Price** 350 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

An _admirer's bouquet_ appears to be a colorful silken handkerchief that exudes a pleasant floral scent until it's picked up, at which point a dozen vibrantly colored long-stemmed flowers appear in the carrier's hand, the stems wrapped in the silk.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per minute;   **Effect** By taking a deep sniff of the pleasant-smelling flowers, you can speed your recovery from nausea and reduce your [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34) value by 1.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** an ally with a free hand ends their turn adjacent to you;  **Effect** You hand the _admirer's bouquet_ to the triggering ally. If they accept the bouquet, they gain a +1 item bonus to saves against [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60) and [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) effects as long as they continue to carry the _admirer's bouquet_. If they're currently suffering from a debilitating emotion or mental effect as the result of a saving throw made during the previous turn, they can immediately attempt a new saving throw against that effect upon being given the bouquet; if they do so, they gain the _admirer's bouquet's_ +1 item bonus to this saving throw. An _admirer's bouquet_ can allow for a new saving throw in this way only once per day.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title

    right="Item 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Admonishing Band](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1226)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Talisman" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=155" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 184

**Price** 20 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** affixed to a firearm

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))</row></row>

 

 

**Requirement** You're trained in [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7).
</row>

</column>

---

This wide strip of treated lizard hide is wrapped around the grip or stock of the affixed weapon, augmenting the unease that your gunshot creates. When you activate it, you fire your gun into the air with the effects of [Warning Shot](/Feats.aspx?ID=3164). If you already have the Warning Shot feat, the target doesn't become temporarily immune to your [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=53), potentially allowing you to Demoralize them again.

</column>

_Aeon armor_ is a magically enhanced suit of [ceramic plate armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=19) decorated in colors of green and gold and bearing the Eye of [Aroden](/Deities.aspx?ID=512) on the breastplate. A suit of _aeon armor_ can be further enhanced by armor runes, but the suits worn by lower-ranking knights typically lack such enhancements. 

An indentation in the middle of the Eye of Aroden that decorates the breastplate of a suit of _aeon armor_ can hold a single [_aeon stone_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3055). Placing an _aeon stone_ in this indentation provides you with all the benefits of having the aeon stone orbit your head, but it protects the stone from being noticed or stolen as easily. You invest _aeon armor_ and the _aeon stone_ within it simultaneously, and they count as only one item toward your [investiture](/Traits.aspx?ID=637) limit. An invested _aeon stone_ slotted in _aeon armor_ also grants its resonant power. 

If you have more than one item with an invested _aeon stone_ (such as if you carry a [_wayfinder_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3117) with an invested _aeon stone_), destructive interference from their resonance prevents you from gaining benefits from any of them. You can still benefit from additional aeon stones orbiting your head, just not those fitted into _aeon armor_, _wayfinders_, or similar items.

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Usage** worn --- Over millennia, these mysterious, intricately cut gemstones have been hoarded by mystics and fanatics hoping to discover their secrets. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to construct the universe in primeval times.
When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an _aeon stone_ with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful Disarm action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are suppressed until you return it to orbit your head again.
There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into a special magical item called a [_wayfinder_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=470) Aeon Stone (Amplifying) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 9,750 gp --- An _amplifying aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +2 item bonus to Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion checks—whichever corresponds to the tradition of the last spell you enhanced with this aeon stone. **Activate—Amplify** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [spellshape](/Traits.aspx?ID=513)) **Effect** If your next action is to Cast a Spell, that spell's rank is 1 higher (maximum 10th rank) for the purposes of counteracting and being counteracted. Aeon Stone (Consumed) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 9 gp --- A _consumed aeon stone_ is a dull lump that has lost its magical properties. It still rotates your head like any other aeon stone and can thus serve as a stylish, hand-free option for various spells that target an object. This _aeon stone_ has no resonant power. Aeon Stone (Delaying) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 350 gp --- When you would die from the dying condition (typically at dying 4), this smooth pink stone automatically activates and reduces your dying value to 1 less than would normally kill you (typically to dying 3). The stone then permanently turns into a _consumed aeon stone_. You can benefit from this ability only once per day, even if you have multiple such stones.
The resonant power allows you to cast 1st-rank [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=148) as a divine innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Envisioning) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 425 gp --- This clear cube allows you to communicate with a limited form of telepathy to a range of 100 feet. The messages are transmitted as a simple image each round. These images are the quality of a hasty or childish sketch but can be roughly understood by creatures regardless of language. This provides no special ability to respond to your images.
The resonant power allows you to cast [_translate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1723) as an occult innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Peering) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 9,500 gp --- This faintly colored prism catches and transforms light. If the _aeon stone_ is in an area of bright light, shades of purple light provide dim light in a 30-foot radius. In that radius, magical items and effects are tinged with purple, the depth of the color revealing their [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) rank.
The GM also secretly rolls a counteract check against any darkness or illusion effect the light touches. It has a counteract modifier of +25. If the light fails to counteract an effect, it won't try again for 24 hours.
Inside a _wayfinder_, the aeon stone cannot catch light. However, its resonant power lets you activate or deactivate the aeon stone's light emitting from the _wayfinder_ as an Interact action. Aeon Stone (Nourishing) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 325 gp --- After you've invested and worn this transparent stone for a week continuously, you no longer need to eat or drink. This time resets if you remove the _aeon stone_ or it's invested by someone else. The resonant power allows you to cast [_air bubble_](/Spells.aspx?ID=5) as a primal innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Preserving) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 150 gp --- This red crystalline star covers you in a faint aura when you are subject to lingering wounds. You gain resistance 3 to [persistent damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). At the end of any turn where the persistent damage can't overcome this resistance, end that condition.
The resonant power allows you to cast [_stabilize_](/Spells.aspx?ID=307) as a primal innate cantrip. Aeon Stone (Smoothing) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 310 gp --- This spherical piece of silvery stone helps you ignore minor issues. You can ignore status penalties to skill checks from [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19), [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34), and [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) conditions as long as the value of that condition is 1. Its resonant power allows you to cast [_guidance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=142) as an occult innate cantrip. Aeon Stone (Sprouting) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 220 gp --- Encouraging the natural growth of life, this green ovoid can often be found surrounded by new seedlings. Its resonant power allows you to cast [_tangle vine_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1713) as a primal innate cantrip. **Activate—Flow of Life** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You are healed by a vitality efect or took void damage; **Effect** You gain 8 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. Aeon Stone (Formulating) **Source** [Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood](/Sources.aspx?ID=257) pg. 81 **Price** 75 gp --- This four-sided prism is imbued with knowledge for the construction of several objects. The stone contains the knowledge of all formulas found in a basic crafter’s book. While you have the stone [invested](/Traits.aspx?ID=637), you have the full knowledge of the stone’s formulas. This counts as having the formula for the purposes of [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=37) checks. While you have this knowledge, you can write the formulas down for later use, such as if you lose access to the stone. You also gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks made to [Craft](/Actions.aspx?ID=2385) while the stone is invested. The resonant power allows you to cast [_phantasmal minion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1631) as an arcane innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Repairing) **Source** [Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood](/Sources.aspx?ID=257) pg. 82 **Price** 75 gp --- This translucent, spherical stone’s center contains a multitude of sparkling, colored flecks. While you have this stone [invested](/Traits.aspx?ID=637), you gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks made to Craft. Additionally, when Repairing an item, you restore an additional 5 Hit Points to the item (10 Hit Points on a critical success). The resonant power allows you to cast [_mending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1597) as an arcane innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Crescent) **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 225 gp --- Once holy relics, the creation of _crescent aeon stones_ was inspired by [Acavna](/Deities.aspx?ID=402), goddess of the moon and protection. The _crescent aeon stone_ continually sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. The resonant power enables you to cast [_forbidding ward_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1535) as a [divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2) innate cantrip. **Activate—Moonbeam** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=579), [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=640), [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The crescent aeon stone fires a blast of silvery moonlight in a 100-foot [line](/Rules.aspx?ID=2388), dealing 4d12 spirit damage to all creatures in the area (DC 22 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save). This is [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2920) damage for the purposes of weaknesses, resistances, and the like. Aeon Stone (Vital amplification) **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 330 gp --- A _vital amplification aeon stone_ improves the flow of vital energy through your body, speeding the healing process and safeguarding your body from life-draining effects. Whenever you regain Hit Points, you regain an additional 1 Hit Point for each 10 Hit Points regained (minimum 1 additional Hit Point). The resonant power grants you [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 5 to void damage. Aeon Stone (Flickering) **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 1,200 gp --- A _flickering aeon stone_ contains a drop of orichalcum at its center. It remains slightly out of phase with reality, giving it a translucent appearance. **Activate—Flicker** ; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _flickering aeon stone_ draws you slightly out of sync with the flow of time, causing you to flicker in and out of existence. You become [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) for 1 minute, but you can’t use this concealment to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) or [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405). **Activate—Enter Stasis** ; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _flickering aeon stone_ pulls you from the flow of time completely, placing you in temporary stasis while you heal, then returning you to reality at the moment you left. You regain 2d10+8 Hit Points. If you have the [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61), [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71), or [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) condition, the value of each of these conditions is reduced by 1. The resonant power grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls. Aeon Stone (Eastern Star) **Source** [The Dead God's Hand](/Sources.aspx?ID=370) pg. 143 **Price** 350 gp --- This red crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. An _eastern star aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) checks. **Activate—Absorb Language** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You touch a creature who spoke a common language in your presence within the previous minute. The _eastern star aeon stone_ becomes infused with this language, granting you the ability to understand, speak, and write that language. This activation persists until you activate it again. Aeon Stone (Western Star) **Source** [The Dead God's Hand](/Sources.aspx?ID=370) pg. 143 **Price** 150 gp --- This blue crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. A _western star aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) checks. **Activate—Illusory Disguise** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _western star aeon stone_ casts a 1st-rank [illusory disguise](/Spells.aspx?ID=1568) to your specifications. If you so choose, the disguise obscures any _aeon stones_ orbiting your head, rendering them [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83) until the activation ends.

Aeon Stone (Olivine Pendeloque) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 98 **Price** 1,200 gp --- An _olivine pendeloque aeon stone_ imparts the calmness of still earth and a solidity of thought, granting you a +3 item bonus to saving throws against effects that cause the [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=5), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19), or [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) conditions. **Activate—Still Earth** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You become confused, frightened, or stupefied; **Effect** The stone suppresses the triggering effect for 1 minute, but the calming urges impose a –1 status penalty to your attack rolls. **Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 604 **Usage** worn --- Over millennia, these mysterious, intricately cut gemstones have been hoarded by mystics and fanatics hoping to discover their secrets. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to construct the universe in primeval times. When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an _aeon stone_ with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful Disarm action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are suppressed until you return it to orbit your head again. There are various types of _aeon stones_, each with a different shape, color, and magical effect. Each _aeon stone_ also gains a resonant power when slotted into a special magical item called a [_wayfinder_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=470). Aeon Stone (Clear Spindle) **Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 604 **Price** 325 gp --- You don’t need to eat or drink while this _aeon stone_ is invested by you. This _aeon stone_ doesn’t function until it has been worn continuously for a week and invested each day therein. If it’s invested by someone else, this interval starts over. The resonant power allows you to cast [_air bubble_](/Spells.aspx?ID=5) as a primal innate spell once per day. It still orbits your head like any other _aeon stone_ and can thus serve as a stylish, hands-free option for various spells that target an object, like [_continual flame_](/Spells.aspx?ID=50). _Dull gray aeon stones_ have no resonant power. Aeon Stone (Gold Nodule) **Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 604 **Price** 230 gp --- When a _gold nodule aeon stone_ is created, its creator chooses a language they know to store within the crystal. When you invest the stone, you gain the ability to understand, speak, and write that language. The resonant power allows you to cast [_comprehend language_](/Spells.aspx?ID=46) as an occult innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Lavender and Green Ellipsoid) **Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 604 **Price** 30,000 gp --- This functions as a _pale lavender ellipsoid aeon stone_, but it casts an 8th-level [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=78) spell with a counteract modifier of +31. The resonant power allows you to cast [_detect magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=66) and [_read aura_](/Spells.aspx?ID=246) as arcane innate spells at will. Aeon Stone (Orange Prism) **Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 604 **Price** 9,750 gp --- An _orange prism aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +2 item bonus to Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion checks—whichever corresponds to the tradition of the last spell you enhanced with this _aeon stone_. **Activate** envision; **Effect** If your next action is to Cast a Spell, that spell’s level is 1 higher (maximum 10th level) for the purposes of counteracting and being counteracted. Aeon Stone (Pale Lavender Ellipsoid) **Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 604 **Price** 2,200 gp --- This aeon stone must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power allows you to cast the [_read aura_](/Spells.aspx?ID=246) cantrip as an arcane innate spell. **Activate** envision; **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** A spell targets you; **Effect** The stone casts a 6th-level [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=78) spell in an attempt to counteract the triggering spell, with a counteract modifier of +22. This can be used only on spells that specifically target you—not area spells that don’t have targets. If it succeeds, it counteracts the spell for all targets if other creatures were targeted in addition to you. Each time you activate this _aeon stone_, attempt a DC 5 flat check. On a failure, the stone permanently turns into a _dull gray aeon stone_. Aeon Stone (Pink Rhomboid) **Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 604 **Price** 1,900 gp --- When you invest this stone, you gain 15 temporary Hit Points. If the stone’s effects are suppressed, you lose any of the temporary Hit Points remaining until it returns. The temporary Hit Points refresh during your daily preparations; they do not refresh if you re-invest the stone, or invest another _pink rhomboid aeon stone_, before then. The resonant power allows you to cast the [_stabilize_](/Spells.aspx?ID=307) cantrip as a divine innate spell. Aeon Stone (Tourmaline Sphere) **Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 604 **Price** 350 gp --- When you would die from the dying condition (typically at dying 4), this _aeon stone_ automatically activates and reduces your dying value to 1 less than would normally kill you (typically to dying 3). The stone then permanently turns into a _dull gray aeon stone_. You can benefit from this ability only once per day, even if you have multiple such stones. The resonant power allows you to cast 1st-level [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=148) as a divine innate spell once per day. The resonant power allows you to cast [sending](/Spells.aspx?ID=272) once per day. **Activate** envision; **Trigger** you are targeted by a mental effect; **Effect** You receive a +4 status bonus to your saving throw against the triggering effect. Whether or not your save is successful, the aeon stone attempts a counteract check at +30 to immediately reflect a copy of the effect back at the originator, targeting it using the creature’s own relevant statistics but controlling the effect as if you had cast it.
Every time you activate this aeon stone, attempt a DC 5 flat check. On a failure, the stone shatters and loses its magical properties forever. The resonant power grants a separate activation. **Activate** command, Interact; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You gain the effect of a [_chill touch_](/Spells.aspx?ID=35) arcane cantrip. Aeon Stone (Dusty Rose Prism) **Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 121 _[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_ **Price** 50 gp **Usage** worn **Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society. --- This _aeon stone_ allows you to cast the 1st-level [_shield_](/Spells.aspx?ID=280) cantrip as an arcane innate spell, surrounding yourself in pink energy. The resonant power increases the damage prevented by your _aeon stone's shield_ spell from 5 to 10. Aeon Stone (Pale Orange Rhomboid) **Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 121 _[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_ **Price** 40,000 gp **Usage** worn **Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society. --- The first time each day you die, your vital and spiritual essences mingle together and reside within this _aeon stone_. You have a limited sense of how many life forces are currently within 30 feet of the stone, which you can potentially use to determine when it's safe to call on the stone's power. You can benefit from the effects of only one _pale orange rhomboid aeon stone_ in a given day. The resonant power allows you to wait more than an hour to return to your body with the _aeon stone_; as long as the _wayfinder_ remains on the body, your body doesn't decay and you can return at any point. Aeon Stone (Pearlescent Pyramid) **Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 121 _[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_ **Price** 900 gp **Usage** worn **Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society. --- While invested, this _aeon stone_ grants the benefit of the [_ghost touch_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=297) property rune to your weapons and unarmed attacks. The resonant power grants a special activation. **Activate** envision; **Frequency** once per minute; **Effect** You gain the effects of [_see invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=271) for 1 round. Aeon Stone (Pearly White Spindle) **Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 121 _[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_ **Price** 60 gp **Usage** worn **Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society. --- When you invest this _aeon stone_, it slowly starts healing your wounds, restoring 1 HP every minute. The resonant power grants you resistance 1 to negative damage. Aeon Stone (Western Star) **Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 122 _[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_ **Price** 225 gp **Usage** worn **Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society. --- This _aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. **Activate** envision, Interact; **Effect** You activate the aeon stone to gain the effects of a 1st-level [_illusory disguise_](/Spells.aspx?ID=159). The resonant power allows you to render all of your _aeon stones_ and your _wayfinder_ [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26) whenever you use the activation to gain the effects of _illusory disguise_. Aeon Stone (Clear Quartz Octagon) **Source** [Pathfinder #179: Cradle of Quartz](/Sources.aspx?ID=122) pg. 79 **Price** 90 gp **Usage** worn --- This clear quartz stone appears to have been smashed and then repaired by pouring molten copper into the cracks and fitting the shards back together using the copper as a sort of mortar. When a non-magical item in your possession with a value of 90 gp or less and a Bulk of 1 Bulk or less would become [broken](/Conditions.aspx?ID=2), this _aeon stone_ automatically activates, preventing the item from breaking by restoring the item's current Hit Points to the item's maximum Hit Points. The stone then turns permanently into a _dull gray aeon stone_. The stone's resonant power allows you to cast 1st-level [_mending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=189) as a divine innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Amber Sphere) **Source** [Pathfinder #185: A Taste of Ashes](/Sources.aspx?ID=188) pg. 77 **Price** 9,800 gp --- If you are [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160), your body regains much of the appearance it had in life, and you gain a +2 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) to [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=46) yourself as a living creature. If you're alive, your appearance is the healthiest version of yourself, and you gain a +2 item bonus to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=50) or [Request](/Actions.aspx?ID=51) that involves your strength or vigor. The resonant power of the _amber sphere_ grants you a special activation to improve your salubrious appearance to a lurid extreme. **Activate** envision; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The stone casts a 7th-level [_mask of terror_](/Spells.aspx?ID=185) on you (DC 34 Will), causing your appearance to burst with a profusion of shocking vigor: your mouth fills with large and bright teeth, your hair animates in grasping tresses, your face flushes with bright blood that seeps from your skin, or similar. The image is unique to each observer, but you remain recognizably yourself regardless of the illusion's form. Aeon Stone (Black Disc) **Source** [Pathfinder #185: A Taste of Ashes](/Sources.aspx?ID=188) pg. 77 **Price** 15,000 gp --- This _aeon stone_ slowly infuses negative energy into your body. The stone deals 1 [persistent negative damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) to you (10 negative damage per minute) so long as it's invested, and you can't recover from persistent negative damage while you have the stone invested. The resonant power grants you resistance 10 to good damage and to positive damage. Aeon Stone (Mottled Ellipsoid) **Source** [Pathfinder #185: A Taste of Ashes](/Sources.aspx?ID=188) pg. 77 **Price** 6,100 gp --- This _aeon stone_ alters your life force. You gain [negative healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=42), which means you are damaged by positive energy and not healed by [positive](/Traits.aspx?ID=128) [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=89) effects. You don't take negative damage, and you are healed by negative effects that heal [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160). The resonant power allows you to cast 7th-level [_false life_](/Spells.aspx?ID=108) once per day. Aeon Stone (Rainbow Prism) **Source** [Pathfinder #185: A Taste of Ashes](/Sources.aspx?ID=188) pg. 77 **Price** 2,200 gp --- While this _aeon stone_ orbits your head, the flat part of its base tumbles to briefly face creatures you can see within 30 feet, as though the stone is watching them. The resonant power allows the stone to capture up to 5 images. If removed from the _[wayfinder](/Equipment.aspx?ID=470)_, you must decide which images to lose. Activate Two Actions envision; Frequency once per day; Effect The stone casts a 7th-level mask of terror on you (DC 34 Will), causing your appearance to burst with a profusion of shocking vigor: your mouth fills with large and bright teeth, your hair animates in grasping tresses, your face flushes with bright blood that seeps from your skin, or similar. The image is unique to each observer, but you remain recognizably yourself regardless of the illusion's form. Item 17 Aeon Stone (Black Disc) Source Pathfinder #185: A Taste of Ashes pg. 77 Price 15,000 gp This aeon stone slowly infuses negative energy into your body. The stone deals 1 persistent negative damage to you (10 negative damage per minute) so long as it's invested, and you can't recover from persistent negative damage while you have the stone invested. The resonant power grants you resistance 10 to good damage and to positive damage. Item 15 Aeon Stone (Mottled Ellipsoid) Source Pathfinder #185: A Taste of Ashes pg. 77 Price 6,100 gp This aeon stone alters your life force. You gain negative healing, which means you are damaged by positive energy and not healed by positive healing effects. You don't take negative damage, and you are healed by negative effects that heal undead. The resonant power allows you to cast 7th-level false life once per day. Item 13 Aeon Stone (Rainbow Prism) Source Pathfinder #185: A Taste of Ashes pg. 77 Price 2,200 gp While this aeon stone orbits your head, the flat part of its base tumbles to briefly face creatures you can see within 30 feet, as though the stone is watching them. You can activate this stone in two ways. Activate Two Actions envision; Effect The aeon stone captures the image of a creature of your size that you can see within 30 feet. It can have up to 3 images captured at a time; if you capture a fourth, you decide which image it replaces. Activate Two Actions envision; Frequency three times per day; Requirements The prism is storing at least one image of a creature of your size; Effect The aeon stone casts a 3rd-level illusory disguise on you, which must be of one of the creatures it has currently captured. While you are under the effects of this spell, the aeon stone is invisible. The resonant power allows the stone to capture up to 5 images. If removed from the wayfinder , you must decide which images to lose. Item 9 Aeon Stone (Cymophane Cabochon) Earth Source Rage of Elements pg. 98 PFS Note The cymophane cabochon aeon stone only provides its item bonus to Perception checks and DCs against Hide, Sneak and Steal actions, not a universal bonus to Perception checks and DCs Price 650 gp Jabalis use the cymophane cabochon aeon stone to keep an eye on their belongings and surroundings. You gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks and DCs against Hide, Sneak, and Steal actions. The resonant power allows you to cast see the unseen as an arcane innate spell once per day. Item 14 Aeon Stone (Olivine Pendeloque) Earth Source Rage of Elements pg. 98 Price 1,200 gp An olivine pendeloque aeon stone imparts the calmness of still earth and a solidity of thought, granting you a +3 item bonus to saving throws against effects that cause the confused, frightened, or stupefied conditions. Activate—Still Earth Reaction (concentrate) Frequency once per hour; Trigger You become confused, frightened, or stupefied; Effect The stone suppresses the triggering effect for 1 minute, but the calming urges impose a –1 status penalty to your attack rolls. Item 3 Aeon Stone (Polished Pebble) Earth Source Rage of Elements pg. 98 PFS Note The polished pebble aeon stone only grants its item bonus to Fortitude saves and DCs against attempts to grapple or swallow the holder; it does not provide a universal bonus to Fortitude saves. Price 50 gp A polished pebble aeon stone imbues you with the strength of the earth, granting a +1 item bonus to saves and DCs against attempts to grapple or swallow you. The stone's resonant power allows you to cast grease as a primal innate spell once per day. You can target only surfaces, not objects, with this spell.

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Usage** worn --- Over millennia, these mysterious, intricately cut gemstones have been hoarded by mystics and fanatics hoping to discover their secrets. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to construct the universe in primeval times.
When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an _aeon stone_ with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful Disarm action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are suppressed until you return it to orbit your head again.
There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into a special magical item called a [_wayfinder_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=470) Aeon Stone (Amplifying) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 9,750 gp --- An _amplifying aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +2 item bonus to Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion checks—whichever corresponds to the tradition of the last spell you enhanced with this aeon stone. **Activate—Amplify** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [spellshape](/Traits.aspx?ID=513)) **Effect** If your next action is to Cast a Spell, that spell's rank is 1 higher (maximum 10th rank) for the purposes of counteracting and being counteracted. Aeon Stone (Consumed) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 9 gp --- A _consumed aeon stone_ is a dull lump that has lost its magical properties. It still rotates your head like any other aeon stone and can thus serve as a stylish, hand-free option for various spells that target an object. This _aeon stone_ has no resonant power. Aeon Stone (Delaying) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 350 gp --- When you would die from the dying condition (typically at dying 4), this smooth pink stone automatically activates and reduces your dying value to 1 less than would normally kill you (typically to dying 3). The stone then permanently turns into a _consumed aeon stone_. You can benefit from this ability only once per day, even if you have multiple such stones.
The resonant power allows you to cast 1st-rank [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=148) as a divine innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Envisioning) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 425 gp --- This clear cube allows you to communicate with a limited form of telepathy to a range of 100 feet. The messages are transmitted as a simple image each round. These images are the quality of a hasty or childish sketch but can be roughly understood by creatures regardless of language. This provides no special ability to respond to your images.
The resonant power allows you to cast [_translate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1723) as an occult innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Peering) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 9,500 gp --- This faintly colored prism catches and transforms light. If the _aeon stone_ is in an area of bright light, shades of purple light provide dim light in a 30-foot radius. In that radius, magical items and effects are tinged with purple, the depth of the color revealing their [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) rank.
The GM also secretly rolls a counteract check against any darkness or illusion effect the light touches. It has a counteract modifier of +25. If the light fails to counteract an effect, it won't try again for 24 hours.
Inside a _wayfinder_, the aeon stone cannot catch light. However, its resonant power lets you activate or deactivate the aeon stone's light emitting from the _wayfinder_ as an Interact action. Aeon Stone (Nourishing) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 325 gp --- After you've invested and worn this transparent stone for a week continuously, you no longer need to eat or drink. This time resets if you remove the _aeon stone_ or it's invested by someone else. The resonant power allows you to cast [_air bubble_](/Spells.aspx?ID=5) as a primal innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Preserving) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 150 gp --- This red crystalline star covers you in a faint aura when you are subject to lingering wounds. You gain resistance 3 to [persistent damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). At the end of any turn where the persistent damage can't overcome this resistance, end that condition.
The resonant power allows you to cast [_stabilize_](/Spells.aspx?ID=307) as a primal innate cantrip. Aeon Stone (Smoothing) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 310 gp --- This spherical piece of silvery stone helps you ignore minor issues. You can ignore status penalties to skill checks from [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19), [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34), and [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) conditions as long as the value of that condition is 1. Its resonant power allows you to cast [_guidance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=142) as an occult innate cantrip. Aeon Stone (Sprouting) **Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 284 **Price** 220 gp --- Encouraging the natural growth of life, this green ovoid can often be found surrounded by new seedlings. Its resonant power allows you to cast [_tangle vine_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1713) as a primal innate cantrip. **Activate—Flow of Life** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You are healed by a vitality efect or took void damage; **Effect** You gain 8 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. Aeon Stone (Formulating) **Source** [Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood](/Sources.aspx?ID=257) pg. 81 **Price** 75 gp --- This four-sided prism is imbued with knowledge for the construction of several objects. The stone contains the knowledge of all formulas found in a basic crafter’s book. While you have the stone [invested](/Traits.aspx?ID=637), you have the full knowledge of the stone’s formulas. This counts as having the formula for the purposes of [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=37) checks. While you have this knowledge, you can write the formulas down for later use, such as if you lose access to the stone. You also gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks made to [Craft](/Actions.aspx?ID=2385) while the stone is invested. The resonant power allows you to cast [_phantasmal minion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1631) as an arcane innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Repairing) **Source** [Pathfinder #213: Thirst for Blood](/Sources.aspx?ID=257) pg. 82 **Price** 75 gp --- This translucent, spherical stone’s center contains a multitude of sparkling, colored flecks. While you have this stone [invested](/Traits.aspx?ID=637), you gain a +1 item bonus to skill checks made to Craft. Additionally, when Repairing an item, you restore an additional 5 Hit Points to the item (10 Hit Points on a critical success). The resonant power allows you to cast [_mending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1597) as an arcane innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Crescent) **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 225 gp --- Once holy relics, the creation of _crescent aeon stones_ was inspired by [Acavna](/Deities.aspx?ID=402), goddess of the moon and protection. The _crescent aeon stone_ continually sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. The resonant power enables you to cast [_forbidding ward_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1535) as a [divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2) innate cantrip. **Activate—Moonbeam** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=579), [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517), [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=640), [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The crescent aeon stone fires a blast of silvery moonlight in a 100-foot [line](/Rules.aspx?ID=2388), dealing 4d12 spirit damage to all creatures in the area (DC 22 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save). This is [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2920) damage for the purposes of weaknesses, resistances, and the like. Aeon Stone (Vital amplification) **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 330 gp --- A _vital amplification aeon stone_ improves the flow of vital energy through your body, speeding the healing process and safeguarding your body from life-draining effects. Whenever you regain Hit Points, you regain an additional 1 Hit Point for each 10 Hit Points regained (minimum 1 additional Hit Point). The resonant power grants you [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 5 to void damage. Aeon Stone (Flickering) **Source** [Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun](/Sources.aspx?ID=259) pg. 79 **Price** 1,200 gp --- A _flickering aeon stone_ contains a drop of orichalcum at its center. It remains slightly out of phase with reality, giving it a translucent appearance. **Activate—Flicker** ; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _flickering aeon stone_ draws you slightly out of sync with the flow of time, causing you to flicker in and out of existence. You become [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) for 1 minute, but you can’t use this concealment to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) or [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405). **Activate—Enter Stasis** ; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _flickering aeon stone_ pulls you from the flow of time completely, placing you in temporary stasis while you heal, then returning you to reality at the moment you left. You regain 2d10+8 Hit Points. If you have the [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61), [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71), or [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) condition, the value of each of these conditions is reduced by 1. The resonant power grants you a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls. Aeon Stone (Eastern Star) **Source** [The Dead God's Hand](/Sources.aspx?ID=370) pg. 143 **Price** 350 gp --- This red crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. An _eastern star aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) checks. **Activate—Absorb Language** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You touch a creature who spoke a common language in your presence within the previous minute. The _eastern star aeon stone_ becomes infused with this language, granting you the ability to understand, speak, and write that language. This activation persists until you activate it again. Aeon Stone (Western Star) **Source** [The Dead God's Hand](/Sources.aspx?ID=370) pg. 143 **Price** 150 gp --- This blue crystal is cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. A _western star aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power grants you a +1 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) checks. **Activate—Illusory Disguise** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The _western star aeon stone_ casts a 1st-rank [illusory disguise](/Spells.aspx?ID=1568) to your specifications. If you so choose, the disguise obscures any _aeon stones_ orbiting your head, rendering them [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83) until the activation ends.

Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to construct the universe in primeval times. When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an _aeon stone_ with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful Disarm action against you. Aeon Stone (Pale Lavender Ellipsoid) **Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 604 **Price** 2,200 gp --- This aeon stone must be activated to provide a benefit. The resonant power allows you to cast the [_read aura_](/Spells.aspx?ID=246) cantrip as an arcane innate spell. **Activate** envision; **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** A spell targets you; **Effect** The stone casts a 6th-level [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=78) spell in an attempt to counteract the triggering spell, with a counteract modifier of +22. This can be used only on spells that specifically target you—not area spells that don’t have targets. The resonant power grants a separate activation. **Activate** command, Interact; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You gain the effect of a [_chill touch_](/Spells.aspx?ID=35) arcane cantrip. Aeon Stone (Dusty Rose Prism) **Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 121 _[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_ **Price** 50 gp **Usage** worn **Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society. --- This _aeon stone_ allows you to cast the 1st-level [_shield_](/Spells.aspx?ID=280) cantrip as an arcane innate spell, surrounding yourself in pink energy. The resonant power increases the damage prevented by your _aeon stone's shield_ spell from 5 to 10. Aeon Stone (Pale Orange Rhomboid) **Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 121 _[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_ **Price** 40,000 gp **Usage** worn **Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society. --- The first time each day you die, your vital and spiritual essences mingle together and reside within this _aeon stone_. You have a limited sense of how many life forces are currently within 30 feet of the stone, which you can potentially use to determine when it's safe to call on the stone's power. The resonant power allows you to wait more than an hour to return to your body with the _aeon stone_; as long as the _wayfinder_ remains on the body, your body doesn't decay and you can return at any point. Aeon Stone (Pearlescent Pyramid) **Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 121 _[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_ **Price** 900 gp **Usage** worn **Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society. --- While invested, this _aeon stone_ grants the benefit of the [_ghost touch_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=297) property rune to your weapons and unarmed attacks. The resonant power grants a special activation. **Activate** envision; **Frequency** once per minute; **Effect** You gain the effects of [_see invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=271) for 1 round. Aeon Stone (Pearly White Spindle) **Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 121 _[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_ **Price** 60 gp **Usage** worn **Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society. --- When you invest this _aeon stone_, it slowly starts healing your wounds, restoring 1 HP every minute. The resonant power grants you resistance 1 to negative damage. Aeon Stone (Western Star) **Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 122 _[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_ **Price** 225 gp **Usage** worn **Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society. --- This _aeon stone_ must be activated to provide a benefit. **Activate** envision, Interact; **Effect** You activate the aeon stone to gain the effects of a 1st-level [_illusory disguise_](/Spells.aspx?ID=159). The resonant power allows you to render all of your _aeon stones_ and your _wayfinder_ [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26) whenever you use the activation to gain the effects of _illusory disguise_. Aeon Stone (Clear Quartz Octagon) **Source** [Pathfinder #179: Cradle of Quartz](/Sources.aspx?ID=122) pg. 79 **Price** 90 gp **Usage** worn --- This clear quartz stone appears to have been smashed and then repaired by pouring molten copper into the cracks and fitting the shards back together using the copper as a sort of mortar. When a non-magical item in your possession with a value of 90 gp or less and a Bulk of 1 Bulk or less would become [broken](/Conditions.aspx?ID=2), this _aeon stone_ automatically activates, preventing the item from breaking by restoring the item's current Hit Points to the item's maximum Hit Points. The stone then turns permanently into a _dull gray aeon stone_. The stone's resonant power allows you to cast 1st-level [_mending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=189) as a divine innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Amber Sphere) **Source** [Pathfinder #185: A Taste of Ashes](/Sources.aspx?ID=188) pg. 77 **Price** 9,800 gp --- If you are [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160), your body regains much of the appearance it had in life, and you gain a +2 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) to [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=46) yourself as a living creature. If you're alive, your appearance is the healthiest version of yourself, and you gain a +2 item bonus to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=50) or [Request](/Actions.aspx?ID=51) that involves your strength or vigor. The resonant power of the _amber sphere_ grants you a special activation to improve your salubrious appearance to a lurid extreme. **Activate** envision; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The stone casts a 7th-level [_mask of terror_](/Spells.aspx?ID=185) on you (DC 34 Will), causing your appearance to burst with a profusion of shocking vigor: your mouth fills with large and bright teeth, your hair animates in grasping tresses, your face flushes with bright blood that seeps from your skin, or similar. The image is unique to each observer, but you remain recognizably yourself regardless of the illusion's form. Aeon Stone (Black Disc) **Source** [Pathfinder #185: A Taste of Ashes](/Sources.aspx?ID=188) pg. 77 **Price** 15,000 gp --- This _aeon stone_ slowly infuses negative energy into your body. The stone deals 1 [persistent negative damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) to you (10 negative damage per minute) so long as it's invested, and you can't recover from persistent negative damage while you have the stone invested. The resonant power grants you resistance 10 to good damage and to positive damage. Aeon Stone (Mottled Ellipsoid) **Source** [Pathfinder #185: A Taste of Ashes](/Sources.aspx?ID=188) pg. 77 **Price** 6,100 gp --- This _aeon stone_ alters your life force. You gain [negative healing](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=42), which means you are damaged by positive energy and not healed by [positive](/Traits.aspx?ID=128) [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=89) effects. You don't take negative damage, and you are healed by negative effects that heal [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160). The resonant power allows you to cast 7th-level [_false life_](/Spells.aspx?ID=108) once per day. Aeon Stone (Rainbow Prism) **Source** [Pathfinder #185: A Taste of Ashes](/Sources.aspx?ID=188) pg. 77 **Price** 2,200 gp --- While this _aeon stone_ orbits your head, the flat part of its base tumbles to briefly face creatures you can see within 30 feet, as though the stone is watching them. You can activate this stone in two ways. **Activate** envision; **Effect** The _aeon stone_ captures the image of a creature of your size that you can see within 30 feet. It can have up to 3 images captured at a time; if you capture a fourth, you decide which image it replaces. **Activate** envision; **Frequency** three times per day; **Requirements** The prism is storing at least one image of a creature of your size; **Effect** The _aeon stone_ casts a 3rd-level [_illusory disguise_](/Spells.aspx?ID=159) on you, which must be of one of the creatures it has currently captured. The resonant power allows the stone to capture up to 5 images. If removed from the _[wayfinder](/Equipment.aspx?ID=470)_, you must decide which images to lose. You gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks and DCs against [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=62), [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=63), and [Steal](/Actions.aspx?ID=68) actions. The resonant power allows you to cast [_see the unseen_](/Spells.aspx?ID=271) as an arcane innate spell once per day. Aeon Stone (Olivine Pendeloque) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 98 **Price** 1,200 gp --- An _olivine pendeloque aeon stone_ imparts the calmness of still earth and a solidity of thought, granting you a +3 item bonus to saving throws against effects that cause the [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=5), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19), or [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) conditions. **Activate—Still Earth** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You become confused, frightened, or stupefied; **Effect** The stone suppresses the triggering effect for 1 minute, but the calming urges impose a –1 status penalty to your attack rolls.
