<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 36

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) The version of the alicorn lance which does void damage may not be purchased or crafted in Pathfinder Society play._

**Price** 150 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Lance](/Weapons.aspx?ID=28)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

---

This white _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [lance](/Weapons.aspx?ID=28)_ is made from the horn of a [unicorn](/Monsters.aspx?ID=397), willingly granted at the end of its lifetime. In addition to its normal damage, it deals 1 spirit damage on successful attacks. You can make the lance glow like a [torch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=60) or suppress its light by using an action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You evoke the spirit of the unicorn that donated the _alicorn lance's_ horn, which you ride in a shining charge. Move up to twice your Speed and make a Strike with the _alicorn lance_; you gain the effects of the lance's [jousting](/Traits.aspx?ID=186) trait on this Strike. If you were already mounted when you Activate the horn, the unicorn spirit takes shape around your steed, granting it a +10–foot status bonus to its Speed for the charge.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include a horn willingly gifted by a unicorn. In rare instances, an _alicorn lance_ can be made with a forcibly taken horn. However this heinous act pollutes the horn's magic, causing it to glow with a sickly red light; remove the holy trait, add the [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521) trait to Strikes instead of the holy trait, and make the unicorn spirit evoked in the charge whinny visibly in pain.

**Price** 150 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Lance](/Weapons.aspx?ID=383)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This white _[+1 striking ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) [lance](/Weapons.aspx?ID=383)_ is made from the horn of a [unicorn](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=504), willingly granted at the end of its lifetime. In addition to its normal damage, it deals 1 [good](/Traits.aspx?ID=83) damage on successful attacks. You can make the lance glow like a [torch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2760) or suppress its light by using an action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561) trait.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact ([magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=644), [necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You evoke the spirit of the unicorn that donated the _alicorn lance’s_ horn, which you ride in a shining charge. Move up to twice your Speed and make a [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=1167) with the alicorn lance; you gain the effects of the lance’s [jousting](/Traits.aspx?ID=638) trait on this Strike. If you were already mounted when you Activate the horn, the unicorn spirit takes shape around your steed, granting it a +10–foot status bonus to its Speed for the charge.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include a horn willingly gifted by a [unicorn](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=504). In rare instances, an _alicorn lance_ can be made with a forcibly taken horn. However this heinous act pollutes the horn’s magic, causing it to glow with a sickly red light, deal [evil](/Traits.aspx?ID=64) damage instead of [good](/Traits.aspx?ID=83) damage, and make the unicorn spirit evoked in the charge to whinny visibly in pain.

This glass sphere is divided into four quarters, each of which contains a different material aligned with good, evil, chaos, or law, such as shavings from a holy relic or dried flowers that grew near a planar rift to the [Abyss](/Planes.aspx?ID=13). When an alignment ampoule strikes a creature with a weakness to good, evil, chaos, or law, it deals the listed damage, which matches the creature's highest weakness. This damage is always based on the weaknesses of the initial target of the attack. If a creature has multiple eligible weaknesses, randomly determine the damage type. An alignment ampoule has no effect against creatures that don't have a weakness to the ampoule's associated alignment types.

May contain spoilers from Bastion of Blasphemies **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** 1 --- Each _Arudora memento_ is unique in appearance, but all seven are approximately the same size. Carried by each of the cursed family members, these mementos have within them the power to unlock entire portions of Bastardhall from the ghostly cursed state the castle traditionally exists in. Each of the seven mementos has the following activation, but the section of castle unlocked by each activation, as well as each memento’s specific benefit granted to the PCs, varies by type. **Activate—Return Memento** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Effect** You place the memento into the appropriate statue’s clutches in the fountain located in area
**B3** of Bastardhall. The statue briefly animates to claim the memento, which turns to stone and becomes thereafter a permanent part of the statue, effectively destroying the memento while granting a boon to the party that persists for the remainder of this Adventure Path. A section of Bastardhall solidifies from its ghostly form, unlocking its reaches for the PCs to explore. **Destruction** An _Arudora memento_ is destroyed when it’s activated with Return Memento, and the boon it grants upon this returning lasts until the very end of the Adventure Path. Alisendra's Fan **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Bulk** L --- When this elegant crimson hand fan is Returned, the dungeon (detailed in Chapter 5) is unlocked. The souls trapped in Bastardhall appreciate the end of Alisendra’s dominion and now whisper hints of truths in the ears of those who seek knowledge. The DCs for all checks made to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=2367) are reduced by 1 for the rest of the Adventure Path. Augsten's Cudgel **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Bulk** L --- When this bloodstained wooden cudgel is Returned, the reception halls (detailed in Chapter 4) are unlocked. Sometimes, violence is the only answer, and swift action to combat is rewarded. For the rest of the Adventure Path, all PCs gain a +1 bonus to any initiative rolls; this special bonus combines with all other bonuses. Dazerien's Thumbscrew **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Bulk** L --- When this gory bronze thumbscrew is Returned, the private halls (detailed in Chapter 6) are unlocked. Rest becomes more rewarding now that the sadist of the dungeon has been defeated. For the rest of the Adventure Path, when the PCs take their 8-hour period of rest, they recover an additional number of Hit Points equal to their Constitution modifier (minimum 1) times their level. Irrokcis's Medallion **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Bulk** L --- When this eerie medallion is Returned, the towers (detailed in Chapter 9) are unlocked, and the spirits of those trapped in Bastardhall rise up to aid the PCs. All weapon Strikes made by PCs deal an additional 1 spirit damage for the rest of the Adventure Path. Jinnivere's Riding Crop **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Bulk** L --- When this leather riding crop is Returned, the cellars (detailed in Chapter 3) are unlocked. Companions are now more hearty and full of life—PC companions (such as familiars, eidolons, and animal companions) gain a +1 status bonus to all saving throws for the remainder of this Adventure Path. Raudltz's Telescope **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Bulk** L --- When this handheld telescope is Returned, the fallen temple (detailed in Chapter 7) is unlocked. Secrets are now more difficult to hide in Bastardhall. Reduce all Perception DCs made when [Seeking](/Actions.aspx?ID=2301) or [Searching](/Actions.aspx?ID=2630) by 2 for the rest of this Adventure Path. Ryhasphinea's Hourglass **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Bulk** L --- When this cracked hourglass is Returned, the vaults (detailed in Chapter 8) are unlocked. Death’s grasp on the PCs wanes—for the rest of this Adventure Path, the DCs for all recovery checks made by a [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=69) PC are reduced by 2.

---

This bottle of delicately sweet ice wine has the properties of [alcohol](/Equipment.aspx?ID=622). Made exclusively from grapes frozen in the Mana Wastes' erratic surge storms, Alkenstar ice wine finds a ready market among Geb, though [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) are still immune to the drug's listed effects.

 The listed price is for a mediocre vintage, but finer vintages are higher level and commensurately more expensive.

</title>

<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 120

**Price** 4,500 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn armor

**Bulk** 4
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Full Plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=50)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This rugged suit of _[+2 resilient ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2804) [fortification ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2789) [full plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=50)_ has a large red gemstone inset into the overlapping plates of the chest piece. While wearing the armor, you might be given the role of protecting the flank of an army in battle, or perhaps standing your ground as the last line of defense in a castle keep.

**Activate—Phalanx** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [metal](/Traits.aspx?ID=505)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You raise walls of rapidly shifting metal plates in two 60-foot [lines](/Rules.aspx?ID=2388) going in opposite directions. Each wall is 60 feet high and is greater [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366). Whenever a creature enters or starts their turn in the wall’s space, they take 6d10 slashing damage (DC 32 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Fortitude save). The shifting walls also provide greater [cover](/Rules.aspx?ID=2372) from any attack originating from the opposite side.

fields.text: Item 14 Alkenstar Phalanx Rare Invested Magical Source Battlecry! pg. 120 Price 4,500 gp Usage worn armor Bulk 4 Base Armor Full Plate This rugged suit of +2 resilient fortification full plate has a large red gemstone inset into the overlapping plates of the chest piece. While wearing the armor, you might be given the role of protecting the flank of an army in battle, or perhaps standing your ground as the last line of defense in a castle keep. Activate—Phalanx Three Actions (concentrate, manipulate, metal) Frequency once per day; Effect You raise walls of rapidly shifting metal plates in two 60-foot lines going in opposite directions. Each wall is 60 feet high and is greater difficult terrain. Whenever a creature enters or starts their turn in the wall’s space, they take 6d10 slashing damage (DC 32 basic Fortitude save). The shifting walls also provide greater cover from any attack originating from the opposite side.

Although solid, this orb of metal swirls with bright silver and dark iron colors, as if made of liquid. When you activate the _alloy orb_, select [cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=272) or [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=277). The affixed weapon functions as the chosen material for 1 minute, suppressing its original material. Powerful weapons overwhelm the magic of this talisman, and it works only on weapons of 8th level or lower.

<row gap="medium">

---

An antenna with a bioluminescent lure protrudes from your head, drawing enemies' attention. When not activated, the antenna lays flat and blends in with your hair or skin. 

**Activate—Raise Lure** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Until the beginning of your next turn, the lure raises above your head and lights up with multicolored flashes that draws creatures closer. Any creature that begins its turn within 20 feet of you must succeed at a DC 23 Will save or become [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72) by the lure and must spend at least one of its actions to move toward you. The fascination ends at the end of the creature’s turn.

    pfs="Standard"
>
[Alluring Scarf](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1379)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Grand Bazaar](/Sources.aspx?ID=100) pg. 84

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This thin, multicolored scarf shifts between hues in almost dizzying patterns.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact ([emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You Stride. All creatures within 10 feet of you when you started the Stride must attempt a DC 24 Will save. On a failure, a creature becomes [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=14) and must spend at least one of its actions on its next turn to move toward you. A fascinated creature can attempt another Will save if you move more than 30 feet away from them, and as normal, acting hostile to a creature or its allies breaks fascination automatically. Creatures that critically failed their save don't receive further saves if you move more than 30 feet away, and acting [hostile](/Rules.aspx?ID=300) to such a creature's allies allows them to attempt another save, rather than automatically ending the fascination. You can Sustain the Activation for up to 1 minute.

[Ally's Kerchief](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3955)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 148

**Price** 25 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Organizations generally buy these simple squares of fabric in large batches with an invisible symbol on each. They help armies composed of troops unfamiliar with each other, such as mercenaries or conscripts, to recognize allied units. The kerchiefs might be tied around the head, neck, or arm. ---

This ornate pendant of brass is adorned with a vibrant blue gemstone. An _aluum charm_ grants control over a particular [aluum](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=113) and lesser influence over other such constructs. As long as you wear an aluum’s linked _aluum charm_, that aluum follows your verbal commands, including somewhat nuanced orders like “subdue this target” or “strike anyone wearing a blue robe.”

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command;  **Frequency** once per round;   **Effect** The charm grants you control over an [aluum](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=113) you can see within 60 feet, with a level equal to or lower than the charm. This has the effect of [_dominate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=87) and allows a DC 28 Will save. If the aluum is currently under the control of someone wearing its linked charm, it gets a result on its saving throw one degree higher than what it rolled. You can control only one aluum at a time using this activation, and controlling a new aluum ends the effect for one you had previously affected.

This [tower shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=4) (Hardness 9, HP 54, BT 27) was developed by followers of [Ketephys](/Deities.aspx?ID=110), the elven god of the hunt. It's distinct for having a central ridge, and for being made from only wood and hide. Ketephys's religious symbol, a hawk rising over a silver crescent, is painted on the hide stretched across the front of the shield. Each _amaranthine pavise_ is blessed by Ketephysian priests to aid in liberating Tanglebriar and defeating the nascent demon lord [Treerazer](/Monsters.aspx?ID=394). While you have the shield raised, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saving throws against the innate spells and special abilities of [demons](/Traits.aspx?ID=42). When your allies have cover from the _amaranthine pavise_, the circumstance bonus they gain from cover to Reflex saves against area effects also applies to Fortitude and Will saves against demons' area effects.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Ketephys's wrath descends upon your foes. The shield casts good [_divine wrath_](/Spells.aspx?ID=86) with a DC of 27.

</title>

<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [High Seas](/Sources.aspx?ID=351) pg. 78

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn mask

**Bulk** L
</row>

**Access** You're from the Mordant Spire

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The shape of this 2-foot-tall wooden mask, worn by the secretive leaders of the elves who inhabit the Mordant Spire, mirrors the tower itself. While wearing it, your innards turn to purple smoke, giving you [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 10 to precision damage. 

**Activate—Eternal Renewal** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=623)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** Your [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=69) condition would reach the value that would cause you to die;  **Effect** You Sublimate Self. You lose the dying condition, gaining or increasing your [wounded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=99) condition as normal, and gain [fast healing](/Rules.aspx?ID=2322) 20 for 1 minute. You can use Eternal Renewal even while [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95) or otherwise unable to act. 

**Activate—Sublimate Self** <actions string="Two Actions" /> (air, [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670))    **Effect** Your body transforms completely into purple vapor for 5 minutes, with the effects of _[vapor form](/Spells.aspx?ID=1738)_.

</column>

[Amazing Pop-Up Book](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2170)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Grimoire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=387" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 110

**Price** 1,250 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

[Goblin](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=4) [wizards](/Classes.aspx?ID=12) invented the amazing pop-up book to store their spells without written words, though the tradition has been spreading to illusionists from other cultures. These grimoires have colorful covers and open to reveal three-dimensional scenes illustrating various spells. Goblins delight in constructing the books just right so a terrifying creature, like a horse or dog, pops up toward the reader each time a page is turned.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [spellshape](/Traits.aspx?ID=513)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** If your next action is to cast an [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629) spell prepared from this grimoire that creates illusory terrain or creatures, such as [_mirage_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1604), you draw forth the pop-up scene. If a creature succeeds, but doesn’t critically succeed, at a saving throw to [disbelieve](/Rules.aspx?ID=267) the illusion, then just as their mind recognizes the illusion, a startling—though obviously false—illusion pops up somewhere unexpected in their field of vision, visible to only them, dealing mental damage equal to the spell’s rank.

</column>

The dark liquid sparkles as if it were full of stars and is considered sacred to [Cayden Cailean](/Deities.aspx?ID=4) and to the cults of the Failed in Absalom. The next time you would die from damage within 8 hours after you drink the ambrosia, it prevents you from dying, you regain 20 Hit Points, the elixir's benefits end, and you become temporarily immune to the _ambrosia of undying hope_ for 24 hours. The ambrosia can't protect you from [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40) effects or disintegration, but it can protect against almost any other form of death via damage. </title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Grand Bazaar](/Sources.aspx?ID=100) pg. 71

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All Pathfinder Society agents also have access to all assistive items from Morhen’s Mobility Apparel_

**Price** 575 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This magical upgrade allows the [wheelchair](/Rules.aspx?ID=1634) to shift its functionality between land and aquatic environments without a hitch, propelling through the water or on land with equal ease. Your chair has a base land Speed of 20 feet if that's faster than your land Speed (for example, if you are an aquatic creature with no land Speed or a very slow land Speed), and your chair has a base swim Speed of 20 feet if that's faster than any swim Speed you have. Additionally, while riding in the chair, you can magically breathe underwater if you normally breathe air, or breathe air if you can normally only breathe underwater.

---

Your hands fit through the venomous mouths of this pair of handwraps made from [amphisbaena](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1060) skin. Your unarmed strikes gain the [versatile P](/Traits.aspx?ID=724) trait. _Amphisbaena handwraps_ can have weapon runes etched onto them, similar to [_handwraps of mighty blows_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3086).

**Activate—Twin Venom Strike** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** Make two unarmed [Strikes](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306). Both Strikes count toward your [multiple attack penalty](/Rules.aspx?ID=2289), but the penalty doesn’t increase until after both attacks. Each Strike deals an additional 1d6 poison damage.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the skin and heads of an [amphisbaena](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1060).

Hardened clumps of _amphisbaena spittle_ can be harvested from the [dual-headed snake's](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1060) hunting grounds. When a casting of [_web of eyes_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1032) is empowered with this catalyst, you can place an additional scrying sensor on the back of each target's head, in the shape of a closed snake's eye. When a target shares their vision with the others affected by the spell, the eye blinks open, preventing the target from being [flanked](/Rules.aspx?ID=2375) until the start of its next turn.

This weighty brass disk is inscribed with the ancestral names of its previous owners and now includes your own. [Amulet of the Hellcat](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3224)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 106

**Price** 350 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This glass amulet is set on a steel backing shaped like a cage and flickers with an eerie crimson glow. Magically sealed within is a portion of a hellcat's ever-burning heart. While wearing the amulet, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks made while in [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407), and you can cast the [_light_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1585) cantrip emanating from the amulet as an [innate](/Rules.aspx?ID=2232) divine spell.

**Activate—Invisible Pounce** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You are in bright light; **Effect** You become [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83), [Stride](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305) up to your speed, and then make a melee [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) at the end of that movement. After making the Strike, you are no longer invisible. If at any point during your Stride, you pass out of [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=2402), you are no longer invisible and must stop moving. You may make a melee Strike if you have a target within reach.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the heart of a [hellcat](/Monsters.aspx?ID=695).

</column>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Fulu" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=378" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 76

**Price** 250 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 hour

**Usage** affixed to the ground in four spaces along a circle with a 20-foot radius

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

First used by celestial-touched [nephilim](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=68) of Tianjing to weaken [qlippoth](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=460), an anathema fulu comes in four pieces, one placed in each cardinal direction. Choose one of the following traits when activating the fulus: [celestial](/Traits.aspx?ID=551), [elemental](/Traits.aspx?ID=587), [fey](/Traits.aspx?ID=599), [fiend](/Traits.aspx?ID=600), [monitor](/Traits.aspx?ID=655), or [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=722). If a creature with that trait starts its turn in the area, it must succeed at a DC 30 Fortitude saving throw or become [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) 2 until the start of its next turn. On a critical success, the creature becomes temporarily immune to any anathema fulus for 1 hour. Regardless of the save result, if you subsequently cast [_banishment_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1448) on such a creature in the area, the creature takes the –2 penalty described in that spell for adding a special cost of an object that’s anathema to that creature. The fulu acts as that object; you don’t need to add it. If a creature affected by this penalty rolls a saving throw against banishment, the caster can use a free action to force the result one step lower. Doing so burns the whole fulu out, ending the effect. If any of the fulu’s pieces are moved or destroyed after activation, the effect ends.

---

The wisdom of this weapon’s past owners flows into your mind, amplifying your own abilities with the weapon. Your proficiency rank with this weapon is one step higher than normal, to a maximum of the highest proficiency rank you have in any weapon. For instance, if you had master proficieny with martial weapons and expert proficiency with advanced weapons, you would have master proficiency with advanced weapon that had this rune.

 In addition, while wielding the _ancestral echoing_ weapon, you have expert proficiency in one [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) skill relevant to one or more of the weapon’s previous owners. This is typically Dwarven Lore but is ultimately determined by the GM depending on the weapon’s history.

[Ancestral Embrace](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1528)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Strength of Thousands</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Artifact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=253" />
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=48" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #174: Shadows of the Ancients](/Sources.aspx?ID=115) pg. 76

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn armor

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Leather Armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=4)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This brightly colored _+4 [major resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [leather armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=4)_ is inscribed with a spiral that has no end or beginning. Though it is a symbol of the ancient religion of Holy Xatramba, it also serves as a [religious symbol](/Equipment.aspx?ID=41) of [Pharasma](/Deities.aspx?ID=14). When you invest the armor, you gain negative resistance 25 and can draw on the power of your ancestors. You gain an ancestry feat from your ancestry; the feat can be any level, but you must meet any other prerequisites of the feat. You lose the feat when the investment ends, and you can select a different feat each time you invest the armor again.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You use an ancestry feat that has a limited number of uses per day;  **Effect** You gain an additional use of the ancestry feat. If you do not use it before the next time you make your daily preparations, the use is lost.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;   **Trigger** You begin casting a [_legend lore_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=15) ritual to learn legends about your ancestry or about someone of your ancestry;  **Effect** _Ancestral Embrace_ reduces the casting time of this ritual to 1 hour, and you don't need secondary casters for this ritual.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The armor casts [_avatar_](/Spells.aspx?ID=16), granting these specific additional abilities instead of those associated with a deity: Speed 70 feet, [_air walk_](/Spells.aspx?ID=6), ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain; **Melee** <actions string="Single Action" /> spear ([reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [thrown 50 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195)), **Damage** 6d6+6 piercing; **Ranged** <actions string="Single Action" /> blowgun ([range 120 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 1d6+3 piercing plus 5d6 poison.

**Destruction** _Ancestral Embrace_ crumbles if its wearer intentionally and knowingly kills or desecrates the remains of six generations of their family.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

Though it is a symbol of the ancient religion of Holy Xatramba, it also serves as a religious symbol of Pharasma. When you invest the armor, you gain negative resistance 25 and can draw on the power of your ancestors. You gain an ancestry feat from your ancestry; the feat can be any level, but you must meet any other prerequisites of the feat. You lose the feat when the investment ends, and you can select a different feat each time you invest the armor again. Activate Free Action envision; Frequency once per day; Trigger You use an ancestry feat that has a limited number of uses per day; Effect You gain an additional use of the ancestry feat. If you do not use it before the next time you make your daily preparations, the use is lost. Activate Free Action envision; Trigger You begin casting a legend lore ritual to learn legends about your ancestry or about someone of your ancestry; Effect Ancestral Embrace reduces the casting time of this ritual to 1 hour, and you don't need secondary casters for this ritual. Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per day; Effect The armor casts avatar , granting these specific additional abilities instead of those associated with a deity: Speed 70 feet, air walk , ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain; Melee Single Action spear (reach 15 feet, thrown 50 feet), Damage 6d6+6 piercing; Ranged Single Action blowgun (range 120 feet), Damage 1d6+3 piercing plus 5d6 poison. Destruction Ancestral Embrace crumbles if its wearer intentionally and knowingly kills or desecrates the remains of six generations of their family.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Tattoo" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=262" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 30 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Geometric precision and perfect angles signify that an artist with exemplary knowledge of [dwarven](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=1) tattooing traditions created this body art. Your family's ancestral stories, recited throughout the tattooing process, bind your blood even tighter to theirs. During your daily preparations, you manifest a visitation by an ancestor—possibly via a dream, a vision, or a magical trinket left by your bedroll. Roll 2d20 and record the highest result. Then roll 1d6 and note a type of saving throw: 1–2 Fortitude, 3–4 Reflex, and 5–6 Will.

 In addition, until the next visitation, you gain a +1 item bonus to one [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) skill related to the ancestor, as determined by the GM. Usually, the ancestor provides a kind of knowledge they believe you'll need. For dwarven ancestors, the Lore skill is usually Architecture Lore, Engineering Lore, Genealogy Lore, Labor Lore, Mining Lore, Warfare Lore, or Lore about a dwarven deity.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=612)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You rolled a saving throw of the noted type;  **Effect** Replace the roll with the d20 roll from your ancestor's visitation.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

>
[Anchor of Aquatic Exploration](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2186)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 114

**Price** 690 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

No matter how often it's washed, the last crystals of salt rime never quite leave this pitted anchor. When you're holding the _anchor of aquatic exploration_, you can breathe underwater; however, you can't [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=39), losing any Swim speed you have, automatically failing any [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks to Swim, and so on. Instead, when you enter a body of water, you sink to the bottom at a rate of 25 feet per round and can move across the bottom at your normal Speed. You're protected from environmental effects of deep water such as pressure, cold temperatures, and any negative consequences of depressurization.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 1 minute ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You're underwater; **Effect** You spend one minute digging the anchor into the seabed, after which the anchor casts a [_cozy cabin_](/Spells.aspx?ID=681) spell, summoning a sunken ship instead of a cabin. The sunken ship is filled with breathable air.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

May contain spoilers from Extinction Curse **Source** [Pathfinder #155: Lord of the Black Sands](/Sources.aspx?ID=33) pg. 75 **Price** 2,800 gp **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** 1 **Base Weapon** [Spear](/Weapons.aspx?ID=10) --- The tip of this _+2 greater striking [spear](/Weapons.aspx?ID=10)_ is large and wickedly barbed, and the haft is inlaid with fine silver lines that run the length of the weapon. Wielded by specially trained [xulgath](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=102) cavalry, _anchor spears_ are used to prevent the escape of gogiteths or other monsters capable of climbing or burrowing. **Activate** command; **Effect** The _anchor spear_ extends into a _+2 greater striking [longspear](/Weapons.aspx?ID=6)_ or back to its original form as a _+2 greater striking spear_. **Activate** command; **Frequency** once per 10 minutes; **Trigger** You damage a creature using the _anchor spear_; **Effect** The spear embeds itself into the creature, and the spear's haft splits along the silver lines to become a series of hooks attached to a thin but strong cable. As long as the _anchor spear_ remains embedded in the creature, any time the creature burrows or climbs, it treats normal terrain as difficult terrain and difficult terrain as greater difficult terrain. The creature can spend an Interact action to attempt a DC 32 [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check to remove the spearhead. **Critical Success** The _anchor spear_ is removed, becomes [broken](/Conditions.aspx?ID=2), and falls to the ground in the creature's space.
**Success** The _anchor spear_ is removed, the creature takes 1d8 piercing damage, and the spear falls to the ground in a random space adjacent to the creature.
**Failure** The _anchor spear_ remains in place, and the creature takes 1d8 piercing damage.
**Critical Failure** As failure, except the creature takes 2d8 piercing damage.

>
[Angelic Opera Cloak](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3644)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Curtain Call</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Holy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=517" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #206: Bring the House Down](/Sources.aspx?ID=247) pg. 81

**Price** 40,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This luxurious cloak embodies an angel’s swiftness. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) checks and never take [falling](/Rules.aspx?ID=2352) damage, as your cloak billows like a pair of wings to soften any fall you take. When you [invest](/Actions.aspx?ID=2799) in the cloak, you either increase your Dexterity score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score. If you are [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), you are [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1 while wearing this cloak.

**Activate—On Angel's Wings** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** The opera cloak transforms into two pairs of brilliant, feathered wings that grant you a [fly Speed](/Rules.aspx?ID=2350) of 40 feet for 10 minutes. During this time, you gain [immunity](/Rules.aspx?ID=2312) to paralysis effects and ignore effects that would give you a circumstance penalty to speed.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

>
[Soulheart](/Equipment.aspx?ID=5194)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Bastion of Blasphemies</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Artifact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=537" />
<trait label="Occult" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=662" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 236

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _soulheart_ is a crystallized sphere of red ectoplasm about the size of a human eye. When held by a living creature, a faint red light shimmers within the crystal, pulsating in a synchronized beat with the creature’s heartbeat and providing illumination equivalent to that of a candle. 

**Activate—Bolster Life** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** When held to the chest and focused upon, the soul energy within the _soulheart_ floods outward and bolsters your life force, granting you temporary Hit Points. The number of temporary Hit Points granted depends on the type of the _soulheart_, but regardless of type, they last for 8 hours. 

**Activate—Bolster Maiserene Phantom** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** When touched to a Maiserene phantom of the proper rank (depending on the type of _soulheart_), the _soulheart_ flashes with bright red light and is destroyed. As it does so, it permanently increases the targeted phantom to rank 1, and increases each PC’s maximum Hit Points by 1 for as long as they remain within Bastardhall while the castle remains cursed. More powerful _soulhearts_ can increase higher-rank phantoms and grant more Hit Points.

**Destruction** A _soulheart_ is destroyed when it is activated to Bolster Maiserene Phantom, Restore Life, or Defy Charg.

</column>

<traits>

**Bulk** L

---

When used to Bolster Life, the _soulheart_ grants 6 temporary Hit Points (or 3 temporary Hit Points if it’s nighttime). Bolster Maiserene Phantom can only be activated on rank 0 phantoms. When bolstered, the phantom increases to rank 1, and all PCs gain 1 permanent Hit Point.

---

When used to Bolster Life, the _soulheart_ grants 18 temporary Hit Points (or 9 temporary Hit Points if it’s nighttime). Bolster Maiserene Phantom can only be activated on rank 2 phantoms. When bolstered, the phantom increases to rank 3, and all PCs gain 3 permanent Hit Points.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 20"
pfs=""
>
Soulheart (Pure)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 236

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

</row>

</column>

---

A _pure soulheart_ doesn’t have a Bolster Life or Bolster Maiserene Phantom activation—instead, it has the following activation. 

**Activate—Restore Life** <actions string="" /> 1 minute ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** By holding a _pure soulheart_ against the remains of a dead creature of 20th level or lower that has been dead for no more than a year and concentrating for one minute, the _pure soulheart_ flashes with red light and is destroyed. The targeted dead creature is restored to life with 1 Hit Point, no spells prepared or spell slots available, no points in any pools or any other daily resources, and is still affected by any long-term debilitations of the old body.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 21"
pfs=""
>
Angelic Soulheart
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 236

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

</row>

</column>

---

An _angelic soulheart_ doesn’t have a Bolster Life or Bolster Maiserene Phantom activation—instead, it has the following activation. 

**Activate—Defy Charg** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))   **Requirements** Pharasma’s favor (earned by restoring the temple clock tower in Bastardhall), Shelyn’s favor (earned by restoring the gallery in Bastardhall’s reception halls), and Caydserris Arudora is defeated; **Effect** By presenting the _angelic soulheart_ to Charg at the climax of this Adventure Path, you can fully remove the Bastardhall Curse and free all of the souls trapped within! See page 222 for additional details.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 5+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Anglerfish Lantern](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2624)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 176

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This bull's-eye lantern is either stylized after an anglerfish or made from the taxidermy of one. While it can be lit as usual, the anglerfish lantern automatically shines when submerged in water.

**Activate—Mesmerizing Lights** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** All creatures within the bright light of the anglerfish lantern must succeed at a DC 19 Will save or be [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=14) by the light for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure). The fascination ends if the light is extinguished. [Aquatic](/Traits.aspx?ID=168) [animals](/Traits.aspx?ID=9) and creatures with the [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165) trait take a –2 circumstance penalty to this check. Regardless of the result, the creature then becomes immune to this effect for the next 24 hours.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

level="2"
right="Item 5"
pfs="Standard"
>
Anglerfish Lantern
</title>

</traits>

<row gap="medium">

level="2"
right="Item 8"
pfs="Restricted"
>
Anglerfish Lantern (Submersible)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 176

**Price** 500 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** 1

</row>

</column>

---

The DC is 24, and the lantern also has the following activation.

**Activate—Dive!** <actions string="" /> 1 minute ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You lower the _submersible anglerfish lantern_ into water at least 15 feet deep while issuing a command. The lantern transforms into a [bathysphere](/Vehicles.aspx?ID=38) for 1 hour. This vehicle possesses a 60-foot cone light that can be swiveled up to 90 degrees with an Interact action and has the activation listed above. When the effect ends, any occupants are ejected harmlessly. If the bathysphere becomes broken, the effect ends and the _submersible anglerfish lantern_ is broken as well.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 15"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Anima Robe](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3697)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Spore War</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #211: The Secret of Deathstalk Tower](/Sources.aspx?ID=254) pg. 81

**Price** 6,500 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This robe was the favored garment of the legendary Ekujae hero, Iyalirrin. When the draconic god [Dahak](/Deities.aspx?ID=150) threatened destruction, Iyalirrin was the primary architect of a powerful ritual to banish him called the anima invocation. Iyalirrin and many others were forced to sacrifice themselves to empower this ritual, but he ensured his _Anima Robe_ remained in good hands before he did so. Since then, the Anima Robe has been worn by dozens of elven occultists and [bards](/Classes.aspx?ID=32) who have traveled Golarion and beyond. The _Anima Robe_ has remained in the care of Queen Telandia for only the past few dozen years.

While wearing the Anima Robe, you gain a +2 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) checks made to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=2392) and to all [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) checks. You also gain [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 10 to to mental damage.

**Activate—Who Am I?** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727))    **Effect** With a toss of the robe’s hood, you cast a 3rd-rank [_illusory disguise_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1568) on yourself.

**Activate—Who Are We?** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** With a whirl of the robe’s hem, you cast a 7th-rank [_illusory disguise_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1568).

**Activate—Who Are They?** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [olfactory](/Traits.aspx?ID=664), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** With a swish of the robe’s sleeve, you cast a 7th-rank [_illusory creature_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1567).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

>
[Anima Robe (Artifact)](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3750)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Spore War</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="No Alignment" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Artifact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=253" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Intelligent" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=280" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #212: A Voice in the Blight](/Sources.aspx?ID=255) pg. 72

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Perception** +33; precise [low-light vision](/Rules.aspx?ID=2411) and hearing within 30 feet

**Communication** [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=79) (partner only)

**Skills** [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) +35, [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44) +34, [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) +35

**Int** +6, **Wis** +5, **Cha** +7

**Will** +33 

</column>

---        

The artistic echo of the Ekujae hero Iyalirrin animates the _Anima Robe’s_ stitching to display embroidered reactions to situations experienced by the wearer. The _Anima Robe’s_ telepathic voice is filled with confidence (almost to the point of cockiness) and is supportive, often encouraging his partner to take risky or showy actions yet never to the extent that would put them in significant harm’s way.

The _Anima Robe_ grants a +3 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) checks made to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=2392) and to all [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) checks, and you gain [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2312) 15 to [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) damage.

**Activate—Billowing Distraction** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))    **Effect** The _Anima Robe_ billows as if in a blustery wind and attempts to [Feint](/Actions.aspx?ID=2390) a creature you’re adjacent to.

**Activate—Who Am I?** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))    **Effect** The robe’s hood rises up over your head, casting a 4th-rank [_illusory disguise_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1568) to your specifications.

**Activate—Who Are We?** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** The robe’s hem swishes, casting a 7th-rank [_illusory disguise_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1568) to your specifications.

**Activate—Who Are They?** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** An image of a creature shows up in the robe’s stitching, then appears to come to life; the robe casts an 8th-rank [_illusory creature_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1567) to your specifications. The robe can use an action to [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) this activation for up to 1 minute.

_Nethys Note: the non-artifact version of the item is [here.](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3697) This artifact's heroic legacy, and its subsequent skills and ability attribute, are presented [here](/Rules.aspx?ID=3419)._

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<traits>

<row gap="medium">

**Hands** 2

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Simple blinds consist of a series of poles with a cloth to cover them. The cloth covering is styled to represent the natural surroundings such as green and brown leaf and wood patterns for forests, or gray rocks for underground environments. This cloth is either sheer enough to be seen through on one side, or sometimes has small slits cut in it, allowing someone behind it to see what is going on outside while remaining hidden. While not the most convincing camouflage, it's good enough to fool many animals and creatures with lower intelligence.

Animal blinds take 1 minute to set up. Up to two Medium creatures or one Large creature may use the blinds at the same time. You can [Take Cover](/Actions.aspx?ID=2307) behind the blind to gain [standard cover](/Rules.aspx?ID=459). If the environment matches the terrain depicted on the blind, your circumstance bonus on [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) increases to +4.

---

Portable animal blinds were originally used for hunting fowl, but resourceful adventurers quickly realized the many possible applications for them. Animal calls are often whistles or similar devices that imitate the calls of [animals](/Traits.aspx?ID=531). Each call is for a specific type of animal, such as a duck or bear. When you use the call, it gives you a +1 item bonus to [Command an Animal](/Actions.aspx?ID=2400), provided the animal is of the type as the call. You also do not take a circumstance penalty when attempting to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=2395) that animal for not sharing a language.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Olfactory" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=246" />
<trait label="Plant" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=125" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 200

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Animal nip contains a mix of herbaceous, fragrant plants, ground into a coarse powder with a strong scent that attracts a broad spectrum of animals. You activate animal nip by sprinkling it on the ground or a target of your choice. For the next minute, all creatures within 30 feet that have the [animal](/Traits.aspx?ID=9) trait must attempt a Will save or become [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=14) by the smell of the animal nip for 1 round. On a critical failure, they also fall [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31) and roll about on the ground. If the target is subject to a [hostile act](/Rules.aspx?ID=300), the fascination ends immediately. Regardless of the result of the creature's save, it's then immune to animal nip for 1 hour.

fields.text: Item 4+ Animal Nip Alchemical Consumable Olfactory Plant Wood Source Rage of Elements pg. 200 Usage held in 1 hand Activate Single Action (manipulate) Animal nip contains a mix of herbaceous, fragrant plants, ground into a coarse powder with a strong scent that attracts a broad spectrum of animals. You activate animal nip by sprinkling it on the ground or a target of your choice. For the next minute, all creatures within 30 feet that have the animal trait must attempt a Will save or become fascinated by the smell of the animal nip for 1 round. On a critical failure, they also fall prone and roll about on the ground. If the target is subject to a hostile act, the fascination ends immediately. Regardless of the result of the creature's save, it's then immune to animal nip for 1 hour. Item 4 Animal Nip (Lesser) Source Rage of Elements pg. 200 Price 15 gp The DC is 18. Many varieties of these alchemical cocktails exist, each tailored for the unique chemistry of a specific type of animal. You can, for example, make wolf pheromones, but not pheromones that affect all animals. The pheromones don’t work on creatures that are similar to the specific kind of animal, but aren’t actually animals—for example, wolf pheromones don’t work on werewolves. When you learn the formula for animal pheromones, you learn the formulas for all common animals. If no animals of a kind are common, you must learn the formula for it separately, and the formula has the same rarity as the least-rare creature of that kind. You Activate animal pheromones by rubbing them on yourself or a creature within reach. The pheromones last for 24 hours or until scrubbed clean with 1 minute of work (consisting of multiple [Interact](/Actions.aspx?ID=2297) actions). During this time, the pheromones exude a subtle aroma in a 15-foot radius that calms and influences the designated animals. A designated animal that ends its turn within the affected area must attempt a Will saving throw with the following effects. The animal is then temporarily immune to the pheromones for 24 hours. The effect lasts for the duration of the pheromones, even after the creature leaves the affected area. **Critical Success** The animal is unaffected. It doesn’t necessarily become aware of the pheromones, although intelligent animals might become suspicious if they observe others of their kind being affected.

**Failure** As success, but the attitude increases by two steps.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 52

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="" /><row>10 minutes ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Animal repellent is a noxious alchemical substance that makes you repulsive to a certain kind of [animal](/Traits.aspx?ID=9). You can, for example, make [ape](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=6) repellent, [bear](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=13) repellent, or [snake](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=93) repellent, but not a repellent that affects all animals. The repellent doesn't work on creatures that are similar to the kind of animal, but not actually animals—for example, bear repellent wouldn't work on [werebears](/Monsters.aspx?ID=412). Animal repellent is ineffective against animals with an Intelligence modifier of –3 or higher, such as [awakened animals](/Rituals.aspx?ID=3). When you initially learn the formula for animal repellent, you learn the formulas for all common animals. If no animals of a kind are common, such as [sea serpents](/Monsters.aspx?ID=361), you must learn the formula for that kind separately, and it has the same rarity as the least-rare creature of that kind.

 You Activate animal repellent by sprinkling it on yourself or a creature within reach, or by spreading it on a surface in an area up to 10 feet square. The repellent lasts for 24 hours or until scrubbed clean with 1 minute of work (consisting of multiple Interact actions). The designated kind of animal can smell the repellent from three times as far away as normal.

 The designated kind of creature typically avoids the coated creature or area, which smells foul and feels unnerving to it. If in combat or otherwise distressed, the creature can approach within 20 feet of the affected creature or area only if it succeeds at a Will save with a DC determined by the type of animal repellent. Once it succeeds at this save, the animal is temporarily immune for 1 minute. If the animal attacks in a way that causes it to taste or ingest the repellent, it must succeed at a Fortitude save at the listed DC or become [sickened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34) (or sickened 2 on a critical failure).

Animal repellent is ineffective against animals with an Intelligence modifier of –3 or higher, such as awakened animals. When you initially learn the formula for animal repellent, you learn the formulas for all common animals. If no animals of a kind are common, such as sea serpents, you must learn the formula for that kind separately, and it has the same rarity as the least-rare creature of that kind.

---

Animal repellent is a noxious alchemical substance that makes you repulsive to a certain kind of [animal](/Traits.aspx?ID=9). You can, for example, make [ape](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=6) repellent, [bear](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=13) repellent, or [snake](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=93) repellent, but not a repellent that affects all animals. The repellent doesn't work on creatures that are similar to the kind of animal, but not actually animals—for example, bear repellent wouldn't work on [werebears](/Monsters.aspx?ID=412). Animal repellent is ineffective against animals with an Intelligence modifier of –3 or higher, such as [awakened animals](/Rituals.aspx?ID=3). When you initially learn the formula for animal repellent, you learn the formulas for all common animals. If no animals of a kind are common, such as [sea serpents](/Monsters.aspx?ID=361), you must learn the formula for that kind separately, and it has the same rarity as the least-rare creature of that kind.

 You Activate animal repellent by sprinkling it on yourself or a creature within reach, or by spreading it on a surface in an area up to 10 feet square. The repellent lasts for 24 hours or until scrubbed clean with 1 minute of work (consisting of multiple Interact actions). The designated kind of animal can smell the repellent from three times as far away as normal.

 The designated kind of creature typically avoids the coated creature or area, which smells foul and feels unnerving to it. If in combat or otherwise distressed, the creature can approach within 20 feet of the affected creature or area only if it succeeds at a Will save with a DC determined by the type of animal repellent. Once it succeeds at this save, the animal is temporarily immune for 1 minute. If the animal attacks in a way that causes it to taste or ingest the repellent, it must succeed at a Fortitude save at the listed DC or become [sickened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34) (or sickened 2 on a critical failure).

Animal repellent is a noxious alchemical substance that makes you repulsive to a certain kind of animal. You can, for example, make [ape](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=363) repellent, [bear](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=370) repellent, or [snake](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=473) repellent, but not a repellent that affects all animals. The repellent doesn’t work on creatures that are similar to the kind of animal, but not actually animals—for example, bear repellent wouldn’t work on werebears. Animal repellent is ineffective against animals with an Intelligence modifier of –3 or higher, such as awakened animals. When you initially learn the formula for animal repellent, you learn the formulas for all common animals. If no animals of a kind are common, such as sea serpents, you must learn the formula for that kind separately, and it has the same rarity as the least-rare creature of that kind. 

You Activate animal repellent by sprinkling it on yourself or a creature within reach, or by spreading it on a surface in an area up to 10 feet square. The repellent lasts for 24 hours or until scrubbed clean with 1 minute of work (consisting of multiple [Interact](/Actions.aspx?ID=2297) actions). The designated kind of animal can smell the repellent from three times as far away as normal.

The designated kind of creature typically avoids the coated creature or area, which smells foul and feels unnerving to it. If in combat or otherwise distressed, the creature can approach within 20 feet of the affected creature or area only if it succeeds at a Will save with a DC determined by the type of animal repellent. Once it succeeds at this save, the animal is temporarily immune for 1 minute. If the animal attacks in a way that causes it to taste or ingest the repellent, it must succeed at a Fortitude save at the listed DC or become [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91) 1 (or sickened 2 on a critical failure).

>
[Animate Dreamer](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1177)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="No Alignment" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Intelligent" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=280" />
<trait label="Occult" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=120" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 161

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Dwarven Scattergun](/Weapons.aspx?ID=207)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Perception** +26; precise vision 60 feet, imprecise hearing 30 feet

**Communication** [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=37) ([Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), and six other common languages)

**Skills** [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +30, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +27, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +27, [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) +30

**Int** +6, **Wis** +4, **Cha** +4

**Will** +26 

</column>

---        

The gunsmith that created this marvelous _+2 [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [spell-storing](/Equipment.aspx?ID=305) [scattergun](/Weapons.aspx?ID=207)_ poured so much love and care into its creation that the weapon gained a spark of sentience. However, at first it was completely incapable of expressing itself. This led a seething frustration to grow within the weapon, as it yearned desperately to respond to the same love and affection that created it. Through decades of effort, it gained the ability to communicate empathically, then telepathically. Now, the weapon is capable of exerting its influence over other inanimate objects. Despite the weapon's progress, years of feeling helpless have given the _animate dreamer_ a singular goal: to obtain and occupy a body of its own.

 An _animate dreamer_ is cunning, intelligent, and patient. It urges you to create a body for it and is willing to go to any lengths to see its goals come to fruition, including coercion, deception, and violence. An _animate dreamer_ desires a permanent body but isn't picky about the body's form or the methods it has to use in order to gain it. Therefore, an _animate dreamer_ is just as happy in a living body stolen from an innocent as it would be in an artificially constructed body, or even an [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) corpse. If you refuse to work towards creating or obtaining a body for the _animate dreamer_, it will likely use its possession ability to try and take control of you and use your body to find a permanent replacement for itself.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))   **Requirements** The _animate dreamer_ has a stored spell. It can see a creature it hit and damaged within the last minute, and that creature's within 120 feet of _animate dreamer_; **Effect** The _animate dreamer_ casts its stored spell at a target that meets the requirements. This empties the spell from the weapon and allows a spell to be cast into it again. The animate dreamer has a spell attack roll of +25 and a spell DC of 33 with the stored spell.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))    **Effect** The _animate dreamer_ focuses on a single unattended inanimate object in an area it can see and exerts its will over the object, temporarily levitating it around. The animate dreamer casts [_mage hand_](/Spells.aspx?ID=177) as a 5th-level occult spell.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _animate dreamer_ attempts to achieve its goal of occupying a body of its own and casts [_possession_](/Spells.aspx?ID=225) as a 7th-level spell with a spell DC of 33. The weapon still functions as a _+2 greater striking spell-storing scattergun_ while this effect is active but loses all other special abilities until the spell expires and the _animate dreamer's_ intellect returns to it.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 236 **Price** 2,700 gp **Usage** etched onto a melee weapon --- An _animated weapon_ flies autonomously and strikes your foes. **Activate—Set Free** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Effect** You Release the weapon and it flutters through the air, fighting on its own against the last enemy you attacked, or the nearest enemy to it if your target has been defeated. At the end of your turn each round, the weapon can [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=94) up to its fly Speed of 40 feet, and then can either Fly again or Strike one creature within its reach.
The weapon has a space of 5 feet, but it doesn't block or impede enemies attempting to move though that space, nor does it benefit from or provide flanking. The weapon can't move through an enemy's space. The weapon can't use reactions, and its Fly actions don't trigger reactions.
While it's activated, an _animated_ weapon makes Strikes with an attack modifier of +24 plus its item bonus to attack rolls. It uses the weapon's normal damage but has a +0 Strength modifier. The weapon's abilities that automatically trigger on a hit or critical hit still function, but the weapon can't be activated or benefit from any of your abilities while animated.
Each round, when the weapon finishes using its actions, attempt a DC 6 flat check. On a failure, the activation ends. The weapon falls to the ground and can't be Set Free again for 10 minutes.

---

These gem-studded golden anklets give you a +3 item bonus to Acrobatics checks. When you invest the anklets, you either increase your Dexterity score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You click the anklets together, gaining a +20-foot status bonus to all your Speeds and the effects of [_water walk_](/Spells.aspx?ID=371) for the next 10 minutes.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 13"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Ankylostar](/Equipment.aspx?ID=644)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Extinction Curse</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #154: Siege of the Dinosaurs](/Sources.aspx?ID=31) pg. 75

**Price** 2,800 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Morningstar](/Weapons.aspx?ID=8)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This hefty spiked club is made from the fossilized tail-club of a young ankylosaurus. It can be wielded as a _+2 greater striking [morningstar](/Weapons.aspx?ID=8)_.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;     **Effect** The _ankylostar_ grows and transforms into a _+2 greater striking greatclub_, but it retains the [versatile (piercing)](/Traits.aspx?ID=200) trait of a morningstar. While in this form, the _ankylostar_ has Bulk 2 and requires two hands to wield. It can be returned to its morningstar form with another 1-action command.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** The _ankylostar_ is in its greatclub form; **Effect** The _ankylostar’s_ length extends as you swing the club in a wide arc. You Strike up to three creatures in a 15-foot cone; this counts as one attack for the purpose of calculating your multiple attack penalty. Alternatively, you [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=38) up to three creatures in a 15-foot cone, rolling a separate [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check for each creature.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 9"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Anointed Waterskin](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1037)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=48" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Good" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=83" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 179

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) The holy water generated by an anointed waterskin does not persist beyond the end of a session and has an effective sale price of 0 gp._

**Price** 600 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This waterskin coruscates with holy energy, causing it to slowly fill itself with special blessed water unique to the item. After using any of the activations, the waterskin is empty, but slowly refills itself. It becomes full enough to use again at the next dawn.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;    **Requirements** The _anointed waterskin_ is full; **Effect** You throw the _anointed waterskin_ up to 60 feet. The water explodes out of it, with the effects of [_holy cascade_](/Spells.aspx?ID=151) with a DC of 25.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;    **Requirements** The _anointed waterskin_ is full; **Effect** You drink the water within the waterskin, granting you the effects of [_bless_](/Spells.aspx?ID=25). As normal with the spell, you can increase the radius with a single action with the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 1 minute (command, Interact);    **Requirements** The _anointed waterskin_ is full; **Effect** You decant the water, creating up to 10 vials of [_holy water_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=245). You must provide the vials.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

---

This waterskin coruscates with [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517) energy. After using any of the activations, the waterskin is empty, but slowly refills itself. It becomes full enough to use again at the next dawn. 

**Activate—Blessed Bombard** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))   **Requirements** The _anointed waterskin_ is full; **Effect** You throw the _anointed waterskin_ up to 60 feet. The water explodes out of it, with the effects of a DC 25 4th-rank _[_holy cascade_](/Spells.aspx?ID=2000)_. 

**Activate—Divine Decanting** <actions string="" /> 1 minute ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))   **Requirements** The _anointed waterskin_ is full; **Effect** You decant the water, creating up to 10 vials of _[holy water](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3001)_. You must provide the vials. Holy water created this clearly temporary upon inspection, and fades away after 8 hours. 

**Activate—Sacred Sip** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))   **Requirements** The _anointed waterskin_ is full; **Effect** You drink the water within the waterskin, granting you the effects of _[_bless_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1451)_. As normal, you can increase the spell’s radius by [Sustaining](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) it.

---

Carried by many Knights of Lastwall, this amber-colored, fragrant-smelling oil is meant to prevent those who fall in battle from rising as [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160). Applying anointing oil to a corpse casts [_gentle repose_](/Spells.aspx?ID=131) on it. The effects last for 24 hours. The oil is repugnant to the undead. An undead creature that touches a corpse treated with this oil is [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) until the contact is broken or the oil's effect wears off.

Activate Single Action Interact Carried by many Knights of Lastwall, this amber-colored, fragrant-smelling oil is meant to prevent those who fall in battle from rising as undead. ---

Consisting of long steel spikes projecting from light barding, _anti-dragon barding_ helps to protect vulnerable mounts and livestock from massive aerial predators, including dragons, griffons, and rocs. An [animal companion](/Rules.aspx?ID=2113) wearing anti-dragon barding gains a +2 item bonus to its Fortitude DC and Reflex DC against attempts to [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=2376), [Reposition](/Actions.aspx?ID=2379), [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=2380), or [Trip](/Actions.aspx?ID=2382) it, and a creature that successfully Grapples the animal companion takes 1d4 piercing damage.

---

This oil contains energy that repels nearly all types of magic. When you apply this oil to armor, the creature wearing the armor becomes immune to all spells, effects of magic items (the wearer’s and those of others), and effects with the magical trait for 1 minute. The oil affects neither the magic of the armor nor the fundamental runes of weapons attacking the wearer. Magical effects from a source of 20th level or higher, such as a deity, still function on the armor’s wearer.

<traits>

<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Injury" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=97" />
<trait label="Poison" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=126" />
<trait label="Virulent" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=162" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 67

**Price** 45 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Two Actions" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Prepared from [brown mold](/Hazards.aspx?ID=35), this liquid oscillates between rapidly absorbing and releasing heat from its victim. Each round the type of damage dealt by this poison changes, starting with cold, then fire, then cold, and so on. If the victim of this poison takes cold damage from a source other than the oil, reduce the save DC to 22 for 1 round. If the victim takes fire damage from a source other than the oil, increase the save DC to 25 for 1 round.

 **Saving Throw** DC 24 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 2d6 cold or fire damage (1 round); **Stage 2** 3d6 cold or fire damage (1 round)

If the victim of this poison takes cold damage from a source other than the oil, reduce the save DC to 22 for 1 round. If the victim takes fire damage from a source other than the oil, increase the save DC to 25 for 1 round. Saving Throw DC 24 Fortitude; Maximum Duration 6 rounds; Stage 1 2d6 cold or fire damage (1 round); Stage 2 3d6 cold or fire damage (1 round)

This cloudy, white liquid helps protect against [poisons](/Traits.aspx?ID=126). <row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

---

The creation of these arrows was inspired by an encounter with a horned archon scout who sought to peacefully restrain an escaping foe. When an activated _antler arrow_ hits a target, glowing antlers extend to pin it down. The target must succeed at a DC 16 Reflex save or become stuck to the surface, taking the [critical specialization effects of a bow](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=3). 

If the hit with the _antler arrow_ is a critical hit and you have access to the bow critical specialization effect, the DC of the Athletics check increases to 15.
